article_content: The three soldiers killed Wednesday at Fort Hood, Texas, hailed from diverse backgrounds. Two were from small towns, while one was from a coastal city in Puerto Rico. They tragically lost their lives in a shooting that also injured 16 others. Sgt. 1st Class Danny Ferguson died while attempting to secure a door to prevent the shooter from entering, according to his fiancée, Kristen Haley, who spoke with CNN affiliate WTSP-TV in Tampa, Florida. 'He held the door shut because it wouldn't lock. The doors, seemingly bulletproof, were not,' Haley told the station. 'If he hadn't been there holding those doors closed, the shooter could have gotten through and shot others.' Haley, also a soldier, noted that Ferguson was from Mulberry, Florida, and was a standout athlete at Mulberry High, graduating in 1993. The town is located approximately 30 miles east of Tampa. He had recently returned from a tour in Afghanistan. 'This was his life. He was proud to serve,' Haley told WTSP. CNN also contacted Ferguson's parents in the Tampa Bay area, but they declined to comment. Staff Sgt. Carlos A. Lazaney-Rodriguez, 38, was from Aguadilla, Puerto Rico, and planned to retire after 20 years of military service, Aguadilla Mayor Carlos Mendez told CNN en Español's Mayra Cuevas. 'They were a very close family,' Mendez said. 'Excellent, decent people. I know his family and his parents. They are good people.' Lazaney-Rodriguez graduated from high school in Aguadilla and enlisted at age 18, Cuevas reported. He was married with a family. Aguadilla, a city of about 60,000 residents, is located on the northwest coast of Puerto Rico. His immediate family, including his father and three brothers, resides in Tampa, Cuevas reported, while his aunt still lives in Aguadilla. 'His aunt was devastated and could barely speak,' Mendez said. 'They were not expecting this. It is a tragedy that this happened seven months before he was scheduled to leave the Army.' Sgt. Timothy Owens, 37, served as a counselor in the Army and had served in Iraq. 'It's terrible that they shot my son,' his mother, Mary Muntean, told CNN affiliate WICS-TV in Springfield, Illinois. 'He was a good person. Why would they shoot a good person who was helping them?' Owens was raised in Effingham, a town of approximately 12,000 in central Illinois. He married in August and had two teenage children from previous relationships, WICS reported. Owens loved the military and intended to make it his career, his mother told the station. 'He didn't answer when I called, so I left a message. 'Son, call me so I know you're OK.' I never got a call back. I thought: 'Oh God, please don't let it be,' his mother said. Regarding the wounded, three patients previously listed in critical condition at Scott & White Memorial Hospital have improved to fair condition, according to the hospital's Twitter account. One other patient is expected to be discharged on Friday, the hospital stated. Five other wounded individuals had been released from Scott & White by Friday. One of the injured was identified as Maj. Patrick Miller of Allegany, New York, according to CNN affiliate WGRZ-TV in Buffalo. Friends indicated that Miller, 32, is expected to fully recover after being shot in the abdomen. Miller's friends organized a prayer service at the Allegany Baptist Church on Thursday night, WGRZ reported. 'He's like a brother,' his friend Dustin Bottone said. 'We are just trying to unite the community and let Pat know that even though we're far away, we're thinking of him.'

'Bibinya sangat terpukul dan hampir tidak bisa berbicara,' kata Mendez. 'Mereka tidak menyangka ini akan terjadi. Sungguh tragis bahwa ini terjadi tujuh bulan sebelum dia dijadwalkan untuk meninggalkan Angkatan Darat.' Sersan Timothy Owens, 37, bertugas sebagai konselor di Angkatan Darat dan pernah bertugas di Irak. 'Sangat mengerikan bahwa mereka menembak putraku,' kata ibunya, Mary Muntean, kepada afiliasi CNN WICS-TV di Springfield, Illinois. 'Dia adalah orang baik. Mengapa mereka menembak orang baik yang membantu mereka?' Owens dibesarkan di Effingham, sebuah kota dengan sekitar 12.000 penduduk di Illinois tengah. Dia menikah pada bulan Agustus dan memiliki dua anak remaja dari hubungan sebelumnya, lapor WICS. Owens mencintai militer dan berniat menjadikannya karirnya, kata ibunya kepada stasiun TV tersebut. 'Dia tidak menjawab ketika saya menelepon, jadi saya meninggalkan pesan. 'Nak, telepon aku supaya aku tahu kamu baik-baik saja.' Saya tidak pernah mendapat telepon kembali. Saya berpikir: 'Ya Tuhan, jangan sampai itu terjadi,' kata ibunya. Mengenai yang terluka, tiga pasien yang sebelumnya terdaftar dalam kondisi kritis di Rumah Sakit Memorial Scott & White telah membaik menjadi kondisi yang cukup baik, menurut akun Twitter rumah sakit. Satu pasien lainnya diperkirakan akan dipulangkan pada hari Jumat, kata pihak rumah sakit. Lima orang yang terluka lainnya telah dibebaskan dari Scott & White pada hari Jumat. Salah satu yang terluka diidentifikasi sebagai Mayor Patrick Miller dari Allegany, New York, menurut afiliasi CNN WGRZ-TV di Buffalo. Teman-teman mengindikasikan bahwa Miller, 32, diperkirakan akan pulih sepenuhnya setelah ditembak di bagian perut. Teman-teman Miller menyelenggarakan kebaktian doa di Gereja Baptis Allegany pada Kamis malam, lapor WGRZ. 'Dia seperti saudara,' kata temannya, Dustin Bottone. 'Kami hanya mencoba untuk menyatukan komunitas dan memberi tahu Pat bahwa meskipun kami jauh, kami memikirkannya.'

article_content: Casablanca, Morocco (CNN) -- Some protesters are not satisfied with King Mohammed VI's proposed constitutional reforms and have called for a peaceful demonstration on Sunday. A member of the movement in Rabat said Saturday, 'The national coordinators have called for a demonstration Sunday demanding a truly democratic constitution and a parliamentary monarchy.' He added, 'The plan as proposed by the king does not meet our demands for a true separation of powers.' King Mohammed VI of Morocco announced significant reforms that will increase the power of the prime minister while reducing some of his own. Morocco's revised draft constitution aims to make officials more accountable, the parliament in Rabat more effective, and the government more powerful, the king stated in a nationally televised address. A Casablanca-based spokeswoman for the reform movement stated, 'There shouldn't be nationwide demonstrations tomorrow, as all Moroccans are happy with the king's speech.' The movement advocates for a parliamentary monarchy, an end to the influence of the king's inner circle, and a crackdown on corruption. Spain and Britain are examples of parliamentary monarchies. In his 30-minute speech on Friday, the king described the draft constitution as 'a bedrock of the special Moroccan democratic development model -- a new historical bond between the throne and the people,' and referred to himself as a 'citizen king.' His actions followed unprecedented protests in the North African country, where street protests are usually tolerated by the state, unlike in many other Arab nations. If ratified in a referendum scheduled for July 1, the most significant change would be empowering voters to select a prime minister, ending the practice where the king has chosen his own appointee. The prime minister has historically followed the king's lead on key matters of state. If Moroccans support the draft, the new prime minister would have greater powers in decision-making and day-to-day management, relieving the king of some duties and aligning the management style with some European Union countries. As an example of power sharing, the draft constitution empowers the prime minister to dissolve the House of Representatives and stipulates that the king must consult him before dissolving parliament. The king said, 'It specifies the conditions to be observed in each case to ensure the separation of powers as well as balance and cooperation between the branches.' The speech followed an announcement in March, after civil unrest in the wake of the revolutions in Tunisia and Egypt. The king instructed a hand-picked committee to consult with political parties, trade unions, and civil society groups on constitutional changes aimed at reducing the monarch's political powers and making the judiciary independent. However, not all civil society groups were consulted, sparking demonstrations across the kingdom from groups who feared being excluded from the new plan. Granting real power to an elected prime minister could address some of the demands from those calling for change. Confirming the authority of the head of government over cabinet members, the draft constitution gives the prime minister the power to propose and dismiss cabinet members. However, King Mohammed will remain a key power-broker in the security, military, and religious fields, according to the draft. For example, the king would still serve as 'the supreme commander of the armed forces' and retain the power to appoint ambassadors and diplomats. Furthermore, the king would retain the power to dissolve parliament after consultations with the new constitutional court, half of whose members he would appoint.
translated_content: Casablanca, Maroko (CNN) -- Beberapa pengunjuk rasa tidak puas dengan usulan reformasi konstitusi Raja Mohammed VI dan menyerukan demonstrasi damai pada hari Minggu. Seorang anggota gerakan di Rabat mengatakan pada hari Sabtu, 'Koordinator nasional menyerukan demonstrasi pada hari Minggu, menuntut konstitusi yang benar-benar demokratis dan monarki parlementer.' Dia menambahkan, 'Rencana yang diusulkan raja tidak memenuhi tuntutan kami akan pemisahan kekuasaan yang sebenarnya.' Raja Mohammed VI dari Maroko mengumumkan reformasi signifikan yang akan meningkatkan kekuatan perdana menteri sambil mengurangi sebagian kekuatannya. Rancangan konstitusi Maroko yang direvisi bertujuan membuat para pejabat lebih bertanggung jawab, parlemen di Rabat lebih efektif, dan pemerintah lebih kuat. Hal ini disampaikan raja dalam pidato yang disiarkan televisi secara nasional. Seorang juru bicara gerakan reformasi yang berbasis di Casablanca menyatakan, 'Seharusnya tidak ada demonstrasi nasional besok karena semua warga Maroko senang dengan pidato raja.' Gerakan itu mengadvokasi monarki parlementer, mengakhiri pengaruh lingkaran dalam raja, dan menindak keras korupsi. Spanyol dan Inggris adalah contoh monarki parlementer. Dalam pidato 30 menitnya pada hari Jumat, raja menggambarkan rancangan konstitusi sebagai 'landasan model pembangunan demokrasi Maroko yang istimewa -- ikatan historis baru antara takhta dan rakyat,' dan menyebut dirinya 'raja warga.' Tindakannya menyusul protes yang belum pernah terjadi sebelumnya di negara Afrika Utara ini, di mana protes jalanan biasanya ditoleransi oleh negara, tidak seperti di banyak negara Arab lainnya. Jika diratifikasi dalam referendum yang dijadwalkan pada 1 Juli, perubahan paling signifikan adalah memberdayakan pemilih untuk memilih perdana menteri, mengakhiri praktik di mana raja memilih sendiri orang yang ditunjuknya. Perdana menteri secara historis mengikuti arahan raja dalam masalah-masalah utama negara. Jika warga Maroko mendukung rancangan tersebut, perdana menteri baru akan memiliki kekuatan lebih besar dalam pengambilan keputusan dan manajemen sehari-hari, membebaskan raja dari beberapa tugas dan menyelaraskan gaya manajemen dengan negara-negara Uni Eropa tertentu. Sebagai contoh pembagian kekuasaan, rancangan konstitusi memberdayakan perdana menteri untuk membubarkan Dewan Perwakilan Rakyat dan menetapkan bahwa raja harus berkonsultasi dengannya sebelum membubarkan parlemen. Raja mengatakan, 'Ini menetapkan kondisi yang harus dipatuhi dalam setiap kasus untuk memastikan pemisahan kekuasaan serta keseimbangan dan kerja sama antarcabang kekuasaan.' Pidato itu menyusul pengumuman pada bulan Maret, setelah kerusuhan sipil menyusul revolusi di Tunisia dan Mesir. Raja menginstruksikan komite pilihan untuk berkonsultasi dengan partai politik, serikat pekerja, dan kelompok masyarakat sipil mengenai perubahan konstitusi yang bertujuan mengurangi kekuatan politik raja dan membuat peradilan independen. Namun, tidak semua kelompok masyarakat sipil diajak berkonsultasi, memicu demonstrasi di seluruh kerajaan dari kelompok yang khawatir akan dikeluarkan dari rencana baru. Memberikan kekuasaan nyata kepada perdana menteri terpilih dapat memenuhi beberapa tuntutan dari mereka yang menyerukan perubahan. Dengan menegaskan otoritas kepala pemerintahan atas anggota kabinet, rancangan konstitusi memberi perdana menteri kekuasaan untuk mengusulkan dan memberhentikan anggota kabinet. Namun, menurut rancangan tersebut, Raja Mohammed akan tetap menjadi tokoh kunci dalam bidang keamanan, militer, dan agama. Misalnya, raja masih akan menjabat sebagai 'panglima tertinggi angkatan bersenjata' dan mempertahankan kekuasaan untuk menunjuk duta besar dan diplomat. Selanjutnya, raja akan mempertahankan kekuasaan untuk membubarkan parlemen setelah berkonsultasi dengan mahkamah konstitusi yang baru, yang setengah dari anggotanya akan dia tunjuk.

article_content: Sources close to Mel Gibson and Oksana Grigorieva report that Grigorieva withdrew her domestic violence claims against the actor during a court session Wednesday morning in Los Angeles. Grigorieva's lawyer also informed a Los Angeles County Superior Court judge that she desired to have the restraining order, which prevented Gibson from contacting her, removed, according to the same sources. Grigorieva had used the accusations of domestic violence in her efforts to alter the custody arrangements for their child. A source close to Grigorieva, who wished to remain anonymous, stated, 'She aimed to show she's a good and responsible co-parent, acting in their child's best interests'. Attorneys representing both parties have not issued public statements regarding the case. The judge has sealed much of it due to the ongoing custody dispute involving their daughter. Gibson entered a 'no contest' plea in March to a misdemeanor battery charge concerning an incident involving Grigorieva last year. The plea agreement placed the actor on three years of unsupervised probation and mandates completion of a 52-week anger management program. It allowed him to enter the plea without admitting guilt. Gibson and Grigorieva remain engaged in a contentious legal battle over the custody of their daughter. The sheriff's department's findings from their investigation have been with prosecutors since August. It remains unclear whether Grigorieva will continue pursuing a civil lawsuit against Gibson based on the violence allegations. CNN's Jack Hannah contributed to this report.

article_content: By Craig Mackenzie Last updated at 12:13 PM on January 9, 2012 Presenter: Cherry Healey, who reads an intimate excerpt from her diary. A BBC documentary about teenage sex, following a girl hoping to lose her virginity, has been branded a 'freak show'. The hour-long program, which includes the F-word and discussions about oral sex and sex aids, is scheduled to be screened on BBC3 on Thursday. However, the Corporation is under pressure not to screen 'Cherry Healey: Like A Virgin', which is scheduled to air immediately after the 9pm watershed. Vivienne Pattison, of TV watchdog Mediawatch, told the Sunday Express, 'The show is terrible, almost a freak show. It’s also irresponsible, inappropriate, disturbing and even exploitative towards some of those featured in it.' 'For a program clearly aimed at a teenage audience, it is extremely irresponsible not to include any discussion of safe sex.' Mediawatch believes there is a danger the Ofcom code could be flouted by using material harmful to the 'moral development' of under 18-year-olds. Former minister Ann Widdecombe has joined Ms. Pattison in condemning the program, which is part of the BBC's Sex Season. She said, 'The BBC should not screen this program. It seems to me that they are just trying to set new boundaries, and to do this at 9pm when a lot of young people will still be up is horrendous.' Shamed: Russell Brand and Jonathan Ross had to make an apology to Andrew Sachs over an offensive prank phone call. Ms. Pattison, who is to make an official complaint to the BBC and Ofcom, claimed the show was 'prurient and exploitative'. She added, 'It is extraordinary that in following a teenager getting ready to lose her virginity, a bikini wax is filmed as an essential part of her preparation, but discussions about safe sex practices are limited.' Ann Widdecombe has urged the BBC not to screen the show. 'The program promises "essential truths amongst the tales of sex and debauchery, to see if losing your virginity is about more than just having sex for the first time". However, it delivers an inconclusive mix of titillating detail and voyeuristic confessional.' The BBC was fined £150,000 for breaching Ofcom's code when Jonathan Ross and Russell Brand used offensive language during prank calls to Andrew Sachs on Radio 2. The controversial program begins with Healey, 31, a former Cheltenham Ladies’ College pupil, reading from her diary when she was 16. She reads: “I’m going to **** Ed senseless.' The show introduces a young man, Dan, from a jazz band who shows her a condom described as a 'willy hat' and jokes with her about sexual positions. She then hosts a discussion with a group of young men, one of whom claims he had oral sex with a woman outside McDonalds. Beth Taylor, a 17-year-old virgin, is filmed having a bikini wax before going on holiday. Ms. Pattison said, “She is packed off to Lanzarote to lose her virginity; while a condom is shown in the show, the emphasis on safe sex practices is lacking.' Ms. Widdecombe told the Sunday Express, 'It is difficult to see how parents and teachers have any chance at all of getting young people to behave responsibly if this is the sort of stuff the BBC is promoting.' 'It will not necessarily help with efforts to reduce teenage pregnancy rates in Britain.' A Church of England spokesman claimed the program was likely to anger people who believed that sexual activity should be confined within a faithful, heterosexual marriage. A BBC spokeswoman said, 'Cherry Healey: Like A Virgin adheres to BBC editorial guidelines and is scheduled appropriately with a strong language warning prior to transmission.'

article_content: Seven-year-old Isla, daughter of Paula Radcliffe, is proving to be a chip off the old block, sprinting alongside her mother and showing a natural talent for running. Isla received a medal for her participation in the Young Athletes Run held in Worcester. In a heartwarming gesture, Isla then presented her medal to her mother, Paula Radcliffe, who had secured third place in the adult 10k event. The scenes evoked memories of 2008 when Radcliffe triumphed at the New York City Marathon. Back then, Isla was a toddler, but she has since developed into an enthusiastic runner, delivering a commendable performance in the one-mile race. The Worcester event also marked Radcliffe's comeback to competitive athletics at age 40, following a hiatus of over two years. Radcliffe, the record holder for women's marathon, completed the race in 35 minutes and 49 seconds. She had previously missed the London 2012 Olympics due to a foot injury. Her plans now include participating in the London Marathon next year as a final flourish to her running career. The complications of her earlier injury had raised concerns that Radcliffe might not compete again. However, earlier this year, she expressed her desire to participate in at least one more London Marathon. It was at the 2003 event that she established her record time of two hours, 15 minutes, and 25 seconds. Before her break, she last competed at the Vienna half-marathon in April 2012, achieving a time of one hour, 12 minutes, and three seconds.

article_content: By Simon Murphy. Major security concerns have been raised after a Mail on Sunday reporter boarded a British Airways flight to London carrying five knives purchased at an air-side duty-free shop. The knives had blades of similar length to those used by the 9/11 hijackers. He walked unchecked onto the packed plane after buying the potentially lethal £20 Swiss Army knives at Zurich Airport, Switzerland. The knives are on open sale, despite similar ones having been used in a plane hijack attempt several years prior. This revelation highlights the disparity of security checks at airports. At British airports, passengers face lengthy queues at security checkpoints and must discard sharp and bladed objects, even ordinary scissors, and liquids over 100ml, including sun cream. EU regulations officially allow passengers to travel with bladed items no longer than 6cm – the length of some Swiss Army knives – but aviation security personnel at individual airports may confiscate them based on their own assessments of risk. Zurich Airport and British Airways stated that they were operating within EU regulations. Critics argued that rules that prevent mothers from carrying baby milk on board yet allow knives to be carried unchecked endanger passengers. On US flights, all types of blades, including Swiss Army knives, are banned. In June, the US Transport Safety Authority scrapped a plan to allow some small pocket knives on flights following a public outcry. Tory MP Nick de Bois said, ‘We need to change the rules. You can’t legislate for the state of mind of the individual carrying the knife, so why put the temptation in front of someone? A 6cm toughened blade, like those in a Swiss Army knife, could be lethal.’ ‘People will find it incomprehensible that you can buy knives after getting on planes.’ After going through security, the reporter made two trips to the Victorinox store, which opened in March, and purchased the knives. The shop, located near a police room, sells an array of knives and even knife sharpeners. Without being asked for a boarding pass or passport, the reporter bought three knives on the first visit and two more on the second. Priced between £20 and £27, the knives were not in protective packaging. The reporter then walked through to Departures, passing under a sign at the departure gate showing a Swiss Army knife with a red cross over it. He then traveled on a packed BA flight to Heathrow with over 120 people on board, including children. Chris Yates, an aviation security expert, said, ‘It seems ludicrous that Leeds Bradford Airport stopped a child from carrying a toy gun because it looked threatening, when that child could have had several knives on their person for mummy and daddy to use aboard the plane. There is a wide disparity in what goes on at airports. If someone turned up at Heathrow with these knives, they’d likely be confiscated or put into the hold.’ Mr. Yates said that since the 9/11 attacks, the door from the passenger cabin to the flight deck is locked but occasionally opened to provide refreshments to the crew. He explained, ‘If you’re sitting in the front, you can see when that door is open, and it doesn’t take an Einstein to work out you can be through there in a few seconds with a knife.’ In April 2011, Kazakh diplomat Valery Tolmachev tried to hijack a flight from Paris to Rome. The 131 passengers on the Alitalia flight watched as Tolmachev held a Swiss Army knife to the throat of a female air stewardess, demanding to divert to Tripoli. The disaster was averted after flight attendants and passengers overpowered the hijacker. The 9/11 hijackers used box cutters which can have blades shorter than Swiss Army knives. A BA spokesman said, ‘Security regulations are set by government bodies such as the European Union. We abide by such regulations.’ A Department for Transport spokesman said, ‘We are assured by Swiss authorities that all pocket knives sold at their airports comply with existing rules, which allow knives with short blades, of 6cm or less, to be carried in hand luggage.’ A Zurich Airport spokeswoman said, ‘Swiss Army knives with a blade of 6cm or less are allowed. ‘It doesn’t matter if you buy the knife or knives before or after the security checkpoint, neither does the quantity, as long as the blade is 6cm or less in length.’
translated_content: Oleh Simon Murphy. Kekhawatiran keamanan besar muncul setelah seorang reporter Mail on Sunday menaiki penerbangan British Airways ke London dengan membawa lima pisau yang dibeli di toko bebas bea di sisi udara. Pisau-pisau itu memiliki panjang bilah yang mirip dengan yang digunakan oleh pembajak 9/11. Dia berjalan tanpa diperiksa ke dalam pesawat yang penuh sesak setelah membeli pisau Swiss Army seharga £20 yang berpotensi mematikan di Bandara Zurich, Swiss. Pisau-pisau itu dijual bebas, meskipun pisau serupa pernah digunakan dalam upaya pembajakan pesawat beberapa tahun sebelumnya. Insiden ini menyoroti adanya perbedaan dalam pemeriksaan keamanan di bandara. Di bandara-bandara Inggris, penumpang harus mengantre panjang di pos pemeriksaan keamanan dan harus membuang benda tajam dan berbilah, bahkan gunting biasa, serta cairan yang volumenya lebih dari 100ml, termasuk tabir surya. Peraturan Uni Eropa secara resmi mengizinkan penumpang membawa benda berbilah dengan panjang tidak lebih dari 6cm – yang merupakan panjang beberapa pisau Swiss Army – tetapi petugas keamanan penerbangan di bandara tertentu mungkin menyitanya berdasarkan penilaian risiko mereka sendiri. Pihak Bandara Zurich dan British Airways menyatakan bahwa mereka beroperasi sesuai dengan peraturan Uni Eropa. Para kritikus berpendapat bahwa peraturan yang melarang ibu membawa susu bayi ke dalam pesawat, namun membolehkan pisau dibawa tanpa pemeriksaan, membahayakan penumpang. Dalam penerbangan di AS, semua jenis pisau, termasuk pisau Swiss Army, dilarang. Pada bulan Juni, Otoritas Keselamatan Transportasi AS membatalkan rencana untuk mengizinkan beberapa pisau saku kecil dibawa dalam penerbangan setelah adanya protes dari masyarakat. Anggota Parlemen Tory, Nick de Bois, mengatakan, ‘Kita perlu mengubah peraturan ini. Kita tidak bisa mengatur pikiran seseorang yang membawa pisau, jadi mengapa menempatkan godaan di depannya? Bilah setajam 6cm, seperti pada pisau Swiss Army, bisa mematikan.’ ‘Orang-orang akan merasa tidak masuk akal bahwa Anda bisa membeli pisau setelah berada di dalam pesawat.’ Setelah melewati pemeriksaan keamanan, reporter tersebut melakukan dua kali kunjungan ke toko Victorinox, yang dibuka pada bulan Maret, dan membeli pisau-pisau itu. Toko tersebut, yang terletak di dekat kantor polisi, menjual berbagai macam pisau dan bahkan alat pengasah pisau. Tanpa diminta untuk menunjukkan boarding pass atau paspor, reporter tersebut membeli tiga pisau pada kunjungan pertama dan dua pisau lagi pada kunjungan kedua. Dengan harga antara £20 dan £27, pisau-pisau itu tidak dilengkapi dengan kemasan pelindung. Reporter tersebut kemudian berjalan menuju ruang keberangkatan, melewati tanda di gerbang keberangkatan yang menunjukkan gambar pisau Swiss Army dengan tanda silang merah di atasnya. Dia kemudian melakukan perjalanan dengan penerbangan British Airways yang penuh sesak ke Heathrow dengan lebih dari 120 orang di dalamnya, termasuk anak-anak. Chris Yates, seorang ahli keamanan penerbangan, mengatakan, ‘Sungguh menggelikan bahwa Bandara Leeds Bradford melarang seorang anak membawa pistol mainan karena terlihat mengancam, padahal anak tersebut bisa saja membawa beberapa pisau untuk digunakan oleh orang tuanya di dalam pesawat. Ada perbedaan yang signifikan dalam praktik keamanan di berbagai bandara. Jika seseorang muncul di Heathrow dengan membawa pisau-pisau ini, kemungkinan besar pisau tersebut akan disita atau dimasukkan ke dalam bagasi.’ Yates juga mengatakan bahwa sejak serangan 11 September, pintu dari kabin penumpang ke kokpit selalu terkunci, tetapi kadang-kadang dibuka untuk memberikan minuman kepada awak pesawat. Dia menjelaskan, ‘Jika Anda duduk di bagian depan, Anda bisa melihat saat pintu itu terbuka, dan tidak perlu menjadi seorang jenius untuk menyadari bahwa Anda bisa berada di sana dalam hitungan detik dengan membawa pisau.’ Pada bulan April 2011, seorang diplomat Kazakhstan bernama Valery Tolmachev mencoba membajak penerbangan dari Paris ke Roma. 131 penumpang dalam penerbangan Alitalia itu menyaksikan saat Tolmachev menempelkan pisau Swiss Army ke leher seorang pramugari, dan menuntut agar pesawat dialihkan ke Tripoli. Bencana itu berhasil dihindari setelah para pramugari dan penumpang melumpuhkan pembajak tersebut. Para pembajak 9/11 menggunakan cutter box yang memiliki bilah lebih pendek dari pisau Swiss Army. Seorang juru bicara British Airways mengatakan, ‘Peraturan keamanan ditetapkan oleh badan-badan pemerintah seperti Uni Eropa. Kami mematuhi peraturan tersebut.’ Seorang juru bicara Departemen Transportasi mengatakan, ‘Kami mendapat jaminan dari pihak berwenang Swiss bahwa semua pisau saku yang dijual di bandara mereka mematuhi peraturan yang berlaku, yang mengizinkan pisau dengan bilah pendek, yaitu 6cm atau kurang, untuk dibawa di dalam bagasi kabin.’ Seorang juru bicara Bandara Zurich mengatakan, ‘Pisau Swiss Army dengan bilah sepanjang 6cm atau kurang diizinkan. ‘Tidak masalah apakah Anda membeli pisau sebelum atau sesudah melewati pemeriksaan keamanan, atau berapa jumlahnya, asalkan panjang bilahnya 6cm atau kurang.’

article_content: Vegas, a rookie police dog, appears harmless with her favorite squeaky toy in her mouth. However, she was rejected from the police force because she doesn't like to bite. Despite her menacing snarl, she failed to make the front line due to her lack of aggression. This 19-month-old German Shepherd is now looking for a new home. She is not suitable for families with young children or other dogs. Northumbria Police rejected Vegas, fearing she would be too gentle on criminals after she failed their rigorous selection process. Police dog handlers initially hoped her docile nature would make her an ideal family pet. However, they discovered she is scared of children, leading them to seek an adult-only home. Vegas was part of a litter of eight pups bred for police work. She was trained to jump through windows, withstand gunshots, and bite criminals. Although she passed some tests, her hesitation to bite led to her rejection. Dog Section Sergeant John Sim stated that not all dogs naturally bite. He explained that a good bite requires precise timing and a determined grip, maintained until the handler's release command. Vegas was too tentative. Sergeant Sim added that Vegas would make a lovely pet in the right environment but needs an adult-only home due to her nervousness around children. Those interested in adopting Vegas can contact Northumbria Police kennels section at 0345 604 3043, extension 68699.

Meskipun gerutannya tampak mengancam, dia gagal berada di garis depan karena kurangnya keberanian. Anjing Gembala Jerman berusia 19 bulan ini sekarang mencari rumah baru. Dia tidak cocok untuk keluarga dengan anak kecil atau anjing lain. Polisi Northumbria menolak Vegas karena khawatir dia akan terlalu lembut pada penjahat setelah gagal dalam proses seleksi yang ketat. Awalnya, pawang anjing polisi berharap sifatnya yang jinak akan menjadikannya hewan peliharaan keluarga yang ideal. Namun, mereka menemukan bahwa dia takut pada anak-anak, sehingga mereka mencari rumah yang hanya untuk orang dewasa. Vegas adalah bagian dari delapan anak anjing yang dibesarkan untuk menjadi anjing polisi. Dia dilatih untuk melompati jendela, tahan terhadap suara tembakan, dan menggigit penjahat. Meskipun dia lulus beberapa tes, keraguannya untuk menggigit menyebabkan penolakannya. Sersan John Sim dari Seksi Anjing menyatakan bahwa tidak semua anjing secara alami menggigit. Dia menjelaskan bahwa gigitan yang baik membutuhkan waktu yang tepat dan cengkeraman yang kuat, yang dipertahankan sampai pawang memberi perintah untuk melepaskan. Vegas terlalu ragu-ragu. Sersan Sim menambahkan bahwa Vegas akan menjadi hewan peliharaan yang menyenangkan di lingkungan yang tepat, tetapi membutuhkan rumah yang hanya untuk orang dewasa karena dia gugup di sekitar anak-anak. Siapa pun yang tertarik untuk mengadopsi Vegas dapat menghubungi bagian kennel Polisi Northumbria di 0345 604 3043, ekstensi 68699.

article_content: All Nippon Airways (ANA) announced plans to recover losses incurred after its Boeing Dreamliner 787 fleet was grounded due to concerns about a faulty lithium-ion battery. ANA, the largest Dreamliner customer with 17 jets, canceled 459 domestic and international flights, costing approximately £9.1 million ($15.4 million). A senior executive stated the airline is prepared to seek damages from Boeing for flight cancellations and other costs resulting from the global grounding of 787 jets. ANA's Chief Financial Officer, Kiyoshi Tonomoto, said the airline is focused on investigating the battery problems and minimizing disruptions by using alternative aircraft. Tonomoto added they would negotiate with Boeing, prioritizing customer safety. Boeing faces increasing pressure following reports they were aware of prior battery issues. ANA reported replacing 787 batteries ten times due to charging failures or other malfunctions. The National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) investigated a battery fire on a Japan Airlines (JAL) 787 at Boston's Logan International Airport on January 7, deeming it a 'very serious air safety concern'. Other incidents included a fuel leak on a JAL flight on January 8, a brake problem on an ANA flight on January 9, and a 100-litre fuel leak reported by JAL at Narita International Airport on January 13. On January 16, an ANA flight made an emergency landing in Japan due to an overheating battery. The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) grounded all U.S. Boeing 787s on January 17, with the flight ban extending to Europe and Asia. Investigators found the battery received excessive voltage. Boeing was ordered to provide a full battery operating history after awareness of problems emerged. Tesla Motors founder Elon Musk stated the Dreamliner batteries were 'inherently unsafe'. ANA reported five of ten replacement batteries showed low charge, and three failed to operate normally. All 50 Boeing 787s were grounded following the battery fire and the emergency landing. Boeing CEO Jim McNerney maintains plans to increase 787 production and retain lithium-ion batteries, stating replacements were for maintenance, not safety. McNerney said progress is being made in identifying the problem's cause without providing a timeline for the plane's return. Tonomoto anticipates a three percent revenue reduction for the fiscal year ending March 31 if 787 services remain suspended, resulting in minimal profit impact, with gradual loss reduction expected. The Dreamliner is the first airliner extensively using lithium-ion batteries, which charge faster and are more space-efficient but prone to overheating and requiring enhanced safety measures.

ANA, pelanggan Dreamliner terbesar dengan 17 pesawat, membatalkan 459 penerbangan domestik dan internasional, menyebabkan kerugian sekitar £9,1 juta ($15,4 juta). Seorang eksekutif senior menyatakan bahwa maskapai siap menuntut ganti rugi dari Boeing atas pembatalan penerbangan dan biaya lain akibat pelarangan terbang global pesawat 787. Chief Financial Officer ANA, Kiyoshi Tonomoto, mengatakan maskapai berfokus pada penyelidikan masalah baterai dan meminimalkan gangguan dengan menggunakan pesawat alternatif. Tonomoto menambahkan bahwa mereka akan bernegosiasi dengan Boeing, mengutamakan keselamatan penumpang. Boeing menghadapi tekanan yang meningkat setelah laporan bahwa mereka mengetahui masalah baterai sebelumnya. ANA melaporkan penggantian baterai 787 sebanyak sepuluh kali karena kegagalan pengisian atau masalah lainnya. Dewan Keselamatan Transportasi Nasional (NTSB) menyelidiki kebakaran baterai pada Japan Airlines (JAL) 787 di Bandara Internasional Logan Boston pada 7 Januari, dan menyatakannya sebagai 'masalah keselamatan udara yang sangat serius'. Insiden lain termasuk kebocoran bahan bakar pada penerbangan JAL pada 8 Januari, masalah rem pada penerbangan ANA pada 9 Januari, dan kebocoran bahan bakar 100 liter yang dilaporkan oleh JAL di Bandara Internasional Narita pada 13 Januari. Pada 16 Januari, penerbangan ANA melakukan pendaratan darurat di Jepang karena baterai yang terlalu panas. Administrasi Penerbangan Federal (FAA) melarang terbang semua Boeing 787 AS pada 17 Januari, dan larangan tersebut diperluas ke Eropa dan Asia. Penyelidik menemukan bahwa baterai menerima tegangan berlebih. Boeing diperintahkan untuk memberikan catatan lengkap riwayat operasional baterai setelah masalah tersebut terungkap. ANA melaporkan bahwa lima dari sepuluh baterai pengganti menunjukkan pengisian daya yang rendah, dan tiga lainnya gagal beroperasi secara normal. Semua 50 Boeing 787 dilarang terbang setelah kebakaran baterai dan pendaratan darurat tersebut. CEO Boeing, Jim McNerney, tetap pada rencana untuk meningkatkan produksi 787 dan mempertahankan penggunaan baterai lithium-ion, menyatakan bahwa penggantian dilakukan untuk pemeliharaan, bukan karena masalah keselamatan. McNerney mengatakan bahwa kemajuan sedang dibuat dalam mengidentifikasi penyebab masalah, tetapi tidak memberikan perkiraan waktu kapan pesawat akan kembali beroperasi. Tonomoto memperkirakan penurunan pendapatan sebesar tiga persen untuk tahun fiskal yang berakhir pada 31 Maret jika layanan 787 tetap ditangguhkan, yang akan berdampak minimal pada laba, dengan penurunan kerugian secara bertahap yang diperkirakan. Dreamliner adalah pesawat pertama yang menggunakan baterai lithium-ion secara ekstensif, yang mengisi daya lebih cepat dan lebih hemat ruang, tetapi rentan terhadap panas berlebih dan memerlukan langkah-langkah pengamanan tambahan.

article_content: Day two of the Davos forum featured prominent figures addressing key global challenges. With over 70 sessions scheduled, here's a curated look at some of the highlights from January 23. At 10:10, Iranian President Hassan Rouhani discussed Iran's role on the global stage. Following him at 10:40, Australian Prime Minister Tony Abbott, in his capacity as G20 chair, addressed the forum. The topic of migration in Europe, a source of both prospects and challenges, was debated at 12:30. Panelists including former U.N. Secretary General Kofi Annan, Goldman Sachs chairman Peter D. Sutherland, and European Parliament President Martin Schulz explored whether governments should improve integration policies or restrict entry. At 13:00, ministers from India, South Africa, Brazil, and Russia discussed the slowing growth of the BRICS economies, a situation some have termed a 'BRICS Midlife Crisis.' Later in the day, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu gave a special address at 14:15, followed by Mexican President Enrique Pena Nieto at 15:45. A panel discussion on the humanitarian crisis in Syria commenced at 16:15. The panel included International Red Cross president Peter Maurer, UN High Commissioner for Refugees Antonio Guterres, and the foreign ministers of Syria's neighbors, Jordan (Nasser Sami Judeh) and Turkey (Ahmet Davutoglu). They explored potential international responses to the crisis, where over 2.2 million Syrians have fled their homes, more than half of whom are children. Concluding the day at 17:15, European Prime Ministers Enrico Letta (Italy), Enda Kenny (Ireland), and Fredrik Reinfeldt (Sweden) joined European Commission President Jose Manuel Barroso to discuss Europe's transition from crisis management to developing a sustainable strategy for economic competitiveness.

Mengikutinya pada pukul 10:40, Perdana Menteri Australia Tony Abbott, sebagai ketua G20, berpidato di forum tersebut. Sutherland, dan Presiden Parlemen Eropa Martin Schulz, menjajaki apakah pemerintah harus meningkatkan kebijakan integrasi atau justru membatasi masuknya imigran. Pada pukul 13:00, para menteri dari India, Afrika Selatan, Brasil, dan Rusia membahas perlambatan pertumbuhan ekonomi negara-negara BRICS, sebuah situasi yang disebut sebagian orang sebagai 'Krisis Paruh Baya BRICS.' Kemudian, Perdana Menteri Israel Benjamin Netanyahu menyampaikan pidato khusus pada pukul 14:15, diikuti oleh Presiden Meksiko Enrique Pena Nieto pada pukul 15:45. Diskusi panel tentang krisis kemanusiaan di Suriah dimulai pada pukul 16:15. Panel ini melibatkan Presiden Palang Merah Internasional Peter Maurer, Komisaris Tinggi PBB untuk Pengungsi Antonio Guterres, dan menteri luar negeri negara-negara tetangga Suriah, yaitu Yordania (Nasser Sami Judeh) dan Turki (Ahmet Davutoglu). Menutup hari itu pada pukul 17:15, para Perdana Menteri Eropa, yaitu Enrico Letta (Italia), Enda Kenny (Irlandia), dan Fredrik Reinfeldt (Swedia) bergabung dengan Presiden Komisi Eropa Jose Manuel Barroso untuk membahas transisi Eropa dari manajemen krisis menuju pengembangan strategi berkelanjutan untuk meningkatkan daya saing ekonomi.

article_content: A legendary Aston Martin DBS, famous for its role in the television series 'The Persuaders,' is set to be auctioned off and could fetch £550,000. This iconic vehicle, often driven by Roger Moore as the character Lord Brett Sinclair in the 1971 show, is a bright yellow, customized sports car. 'The Persuaders,' co-starring Tony Curtis as Danny Wilde, was a high-budget production filmed in various glamorous locations. While Curtis favored a Ferrari, Moore preferred the Aston Martin DBS, which the manufacturer provided. Customized specifically for the show, the car features a four-litre straight-six engine instead of the standard V8, and includes V8 wheels, hubs, and badging. With approximately 285bhp, this eye-catching DBS can accelerate from 0-60mph in 7.1 seconds, reaching a top speed of 140mph. The car prominently displayed Lord Brett Sinclair's initials, 'BS 1,' on its license plates in nearly every episode, with a single exception where it appeared with its original UK registration, PPP 6H. The show aired for 24 episodes before Moore transitioned to playing James Bond. During its time on the show, the Aston Martin covered 5,000 miles and underwent some wear, after which Aston Martin serviced and resold the vehicle. The vehicle's trunk bears the signatures of both Tony Curtis and Roger Moore. Having had five owners since its television debut, the car has recently been showcased at prestigious automotive events, including the 2013 Concorso d'Eleganza Villa d'Este in Italy. Auction house Bonhams will feature the DBS at their annual Aston Martin sale on May 17 in Newport Pagnell, anticipating a sale price of £550,000. Bonhams describes it as 'a rare opportunity to own an automotive legend with significant cultural importance.' According to Tim Schofield from Bonhams, the car is instantly recognizable from television and is in excellent condition, having been restored by Aston Martin 20 years ago and meticulously maintained. Schofield expects substantial interest due to the car's association with a famous TV show and personality. 'The Persuaders' was an action-adventure series airing in 1971 and 1972, centered around Lord Brett Sinclair and Danny Wilde solving cases the courts couldn't. The characters came from contrasting backgrounds, with Sinclair being a British aristocrat and Wilde a New Yorker with a tough upbringing. The show's split-screen title sequence uniquely portrayed the characters' lives, designed to avoid either actor receiving top billing. The ITV show ran for 24 episodes from September 1971 to February 1972 before Moore's casting as James Bond led to its cancellation. Filming took place in France, Italy, and England between May 1970 and June 1971.

Setelah memiliki lima pemilik sejak debut televisinya, mobil ini baru-baru ini dipamerkan di acara otomotif bergengsi, termasuk Concorso d'Eleganza Villa d'Este 2013 di Italia. Rumah lelang Bonhams akan menampilkan DBS di penjualan Aston Martin tahunan mereka pada 17 Mei di Newport Pagnell, mengantisipasi harga jual sebesar £550.000. Bonhams menggambarkannya sebagai 'kesempatan langka untuk memiliki legenda otomotif dengan kepentingan budaya yang signifikan'. Menurut Tim Schofield dari Bonhams, mobil itu langsung dapat dikenali dari televisi dan dalam kondisi sangat baik, telah dipulihkan oleh Aston Martin 20 tahun lalu dan dipelihara dengan cermat. Schofield mengharapkan minat yang besar karena keterkaitan mobil itu dengan acara TV dan kepribadian terkenal. 'The Persuaders' adalah serial aksi-petualangan yang ditayangkan pada tahun 1971 dan 1972, yang berpusat pada Lord Brett Sinclair dan Danny Wilde yang memecahkan kasus-kasus yang tidak dapat diselesaikan oleh pengadilan. Para karakter berasal dari latar belakang yang kontras, dengan Sinclair menjadi seorang aristokrat Inggris dan Wilde seorang warga New York dengan masa kecil yang sulit. Urutan judul layar terpisah acara itu secara unik menggambarkan kehidupan para karakter, dirancang untuk menghindari salah satu aktor menerima tagihan utama. Acara ITV itu ditayangkan selama 24 episode dari September 1971 hingga Februari 1972 sebelum pemilihan Moore sebagai James Bond menyebabkan pembatalannya. Pengambilan gambar berlangsung di Prancis, Italia, dan Inggris antara Mei 1970 dan Juni 1971.

article_content: Roma made Serie A history by winning its first 10 games this season, following a 1-0 victory over Chievo. This result solidified Roma's five-point lead over Juventus and Napoli at the top of the league table. Roma dominated possession with 65%, but the game remained scoreless until Marco Borriello scored a header in the 67th minute, ending Chievo's resistance. Francesco Totti, sidelined due to injury, couldn't assist Roma. Borriello's goal was one of Roma's 18 shots, while Chievo only managed two. Previously, Roma secured a 1-0 victory at Udinese, marking their ninth consecutive win and matching Juventus' record from the 2005/06 season. Juventus' title from that campaign was later revoked due to a match-fixing scandal. Atletico Madrid kept pace in La Liga as Diego Costa, days after committing to play for Spain instead of Brazil, scored in their 2-1 win against Granada. Costa's goal, a penalty, put him ahead of Cristiano Ronaldo in the scoring charts with 12 goals. David Villa also scored a penalty. Villa earned both penalties. Granada scored a late goal after Atletico's Filipe Luis was sent off in the 89th minute, but Atletico secured the win. 'What really makes me happy is the effort made by the players,' Atletico manager Diego Simeone said. 'It's not easy to win, win, win and keep winning.' Atletico now has 30 points, trailing Barcelona by one point, after achieving 10 wins and one loss. Despite Lionel Messi's recent scoring drought, Barcelona defeated Celta Vigo 3-0, temporarily increasing their lead to four points. Real Madrid is third in the standings. Following their loss to Barcelona in El Clasico, Real Madrid bounced back with a 7-3 victory over Sevilla. Cristiano Ronaldo scored a hat-trick, and Gareth Bale scored his first goals at the Bernabeu. A strike by French Ligue 1 and Ligue 2 clubs is increasingly likely after President Francois Hollande maintained his plan to impose a 75% tax rate on high earners for two years. A meeting with club owners failed to change Hollande's position, suggesting games between November 29 and December 2 will be affected. The tax scheme, aimed at reducing France's budget deficit, would affect those earning over 1 million euros ($1.38 million) annually. The clubs argue that they are unfairly targeted, as many are facing financial difficulties. 'Club representatives have not been heard despite several constructive proposals,' the Union of Professional Football Clubs stated. 'This tax, which was initially meant for the richest, will in our case impact companies in debt.' The tax would be levied on the clubs, not the players.

Sebelumnya, Roma mengamankan kemenangan 1-0 di Udinese, menandai kemenangan kesembilan berturut-turut mereka dan menyamai rekor Juventus dari musim 2005/06. Gelar Juventus dari musim itu kemudian dicabut akibat skandal pengaturan pertandingan. Atletico Madrid terus menjaga jarak di La Liga saat Diego Costa, beberapa hari setelah memutuskan untuk bermain untuk Spanyol daripada Brasil, mencetak gol dalam kemenangan 2-1 mereka melawan Granada. Gol Costa, melalui penalti, menempatkannya di depan Cristiano Ronaldo dalam daftar pencetak gol dengan 12 gol. David Villa juga mencetak gol penalti. Villa mendapatkan kedua penalti tersebut. Granada mencetak gol balasan di menit-menit akhir setelah Filipe Luis dari Atletico dikeluarkan dari lapangan pada menit ke-89, tetapi Atletico berhasil mengamankan kemenangan. 'Yang benar-benar membuat saya senang adalah upaya yang dilakukan oleh para pemain,' kata pelatih Atletico, Diego Simeone. 'Tidak mudah untuk menang, menang, menang, dan terus menang.' Atletico sekarang memiliki 30 poin, tertinggal satu poin dari Barcelona, setelah meraih 10 kemenangan dan satu kekalahan. Meski Lionel Messi sedang mengalami sedikit penurunan performa dalam mencetak gol, Barcelona berhasil mengalahkan Celta Vigo 3-0, untuk sementara memperlebar keunggulan mereka menjadi empat poin. Real Madrid berada di urutan ketiga dalam klasemen. Setelah kekalahan dari Barcelona di El Clasico, Real Madrid bangkit kembali dengan kemenangan telak 7-3 atas Sevilla. Cristiano Ronaldo mencetak hat-trick, dan Gareth Bale mencetak gol perdananya di Bernabeu. Aksi mogok oleh klub-klub Ligue 1 dan Ligue 2 Prancis semakin menguat setelah Presiden Francois Hollande bersikeras dengan rencananya untuk mengenakan tarif pajak 75% pada penghasilan tinggi selama dua tahun. Pertemuan dengan para pemilik klub tidak mengubah pendirian Hollande, yang mengindikasikan pertandingan antara 29 November dan 2 Desember berpotensi terpengaruh. Skema pajak ini, yang bertujuan untuk menekan defisit anggaran Prancis, akan berdampak pada individu dengan penghasilan di atas 1 juta euro ($1,38 juta) per tahun. Klub-klub berargumen bahwa mereka menjadi target yang tidak adil, mengingat banyak dari mereka tengah mengalami kesulitan finansial. 'Perwakilan klub merasa tidak didengarkan meski telah mengajukan sejumlah proposal konstruktif,' ungkap Serikat Klub Sepak Bola Profesional. 'Pajak ini, yang sejatinya ditujukan bagi kalangan terkaya, justru akan membebani perusahaan yang tengah bergelut dengan utang.' Pajak tersebut akan dibebankan kepada klub, bukan kepada para pemain.

article_content: From its debut with Natasha Kaplinsky and Brendan Cole, 'Strictly Come Dancing' captivated UK audiences. Viewers adored the graceful dances, elegant costumes, and charming atmosphere, especially with figures like Lesley Garrett and Anton du Beke. It presented family-friendly entertainment suitable for all. Flash forward a decade, and the series seems strikingly different. Simon Webbe and Kristina Rihanoff's rumba, featuring a revealing outfit, drew considerable criticism. This instance isn't isolated. The show now lacks the charm of its initial seasons. The older dancers, modest routines, and sophisticated gowns have largely disappeared. Today's performances are often more suggestive. The contrast is so stark that early episodes appear from another era. Imagine Lesley Garrett's conservative attire fitting into today's show. Similarly, the explicit dances of recent episodes wouldn't have been acceptable years ago. Kevin Clifton's energetic paso doble with Frankie Bridge led to a wardrobe malfunction, while Janette Manrara's routine with Jake Wood raised eyebrows. Kristina and Simon's performance seemed more suitable for late-night viewing. One viewer remarked on a forum that Kristina resembled an adult film star. Ola Jordan also noted the show's increasing lack of glamour, mentioning the shrinking costumes, which can make celebrities feel uncomfortable. Ola's calendars and those of other dancers showcase more revealing poses than their on-screen attire. Pixie Lott and Frankie Bridge's costumes are often minimal. In the past, contestants like Carol Vorderman wore far more modest outfits. While Strictly beat 'The X Factor' in 2011, ratings have since declined, coinciding with the show's increased raunchiness. The original dancers have been replaced by a new generation of thinner, blonde performers. Some viewers feel the show has traded elegance for sleaze.

article_content: At the Wildlife Kilmore Rescue Centre in Victoria, Australia, an adorable baby kangaroo named Anzac has struck up an unexpected friendship with Peggy, a small wombat. This heartwarming bond developed after the two orphans shared a pouch at the center. Anzac, just over five months old, arrived at the center after being rescued in the Macedon Ranges. Typically, a joey stays in its mother's pouch for about eight months, depending on the species, but Anzac was orphaned prematurely. Finding himself without his mother, Anzac was paired with Peggy. The two now sleep together, easing Anzac's loneliness. Lisa Milligan, a worker at the center, noted that the animals are soothed by each other's movements and heartbeats. She explained that many baby animals are orphaned at this time of year for various reasons. The pair's similar personalities contribute to their close relationship; Anzac is very sociable, while Peggy is known to be boisterous and cheeky. It remains to be seen whether Anzac and Peggy's friendship will endure as they grow. Peggy's shuffling gait may not allow her to keep pace with Anzac's hopping. Wombats, though they may appear slow, can move quickly when necessary. Kangaroos, on the other hand, are built for speed and can hop efficiently. While both are currently small, their size differences will become more pronounced as they mature. Peggy will grow into a powerfully built wombat weighing around 30kg, while Anzac will become a much taller kangaroo, also weighing upwards of 30kg. Fortunately, both animals are herbivores, eliminating any threat to each other. If their friendship continues, they could spend their days together searching for lush grass and leaves.

article_content: Hull overcame their disappointing 2014 form with a dominant performance against a struggling Everton, though the scoreline didn't fully reflect their superiority. Ahmed Elmohamady and former Everton player Nikica Jelavic scored in the first half, securing the win. Abel Hernandez delivered a stellar performance, driving Hull's attack. Everton's defensive woes continued, marking their fourth consecutive defeat and leaving them dangerously close to a relegation battle. Despite a slight improvement in the second half, Roberto Martinez's team is facing significant issues that require immediate attention. Nikica Jelavic's goal against his former club increased Hull's lead to 2-0. The Hull City lineup featured McGregor, Chester, Bruce, Davies, Robertson (later replaced by Rosenoir, then Maguire), Elmohamady, Meyler, Livermore, Ramirez (later replaced by Brady), Hernandez, and Jelavic. Steve Bruce managed the team. Everton's lineup included Robles, Alcaraz, Jagielka, Barry, Coleman, Besic (later replaced by Oviedo), Barkley, Baines, Naismith, Kone, and Mirallas (later replaced by Lukaku). Roberto Martinez managed Everton. Kevin Friend was the referee, and Abel Hernandez was named Man of the Match. Hull's victory moved them up to 15th place. Hull's challenging 2014 saw them reach the FA Cup final and maintain their Premier League status, but their home form was a concern. Their home record of 3 wins, 4 draws, and 11 losses highlighted their struggles at the KC Stadium. Steve Bruce dismissed rumors linking him to the Newcastle job, reaffirming his commitment to Hull. Ahmed Elmohamady's header gave Hull the lead. Alcaraz was sent off after receiving two yellow cards. Hull made several changes to their starting lineup, with injuries and tactical adjustments influencing the team selection. Everton's struggles continued, with Martinez facing increasing scrutiny. Everton's defensive vulnerabilities were exposed, drawing comparisons to Martinez's previous team, Wigan. Numerous changes were made to Everton's lineup, reflecting the team's ongoing struggles. Hull should have been awarded a penalty early in the game when Barry fouled Hernandez. Elmohamady's header and Jelavic's lob gave Hull a comfortable lead. Martinez made two substitutions at halftime, bringing on Lukaku and Oviedo in an attempt to revitalize Everton's attack. However, despite creating chances, Everton failed to convert them. After the game, Martinez acknowledged the pressure he was under but expressed confidence in his team's quality. Bruce praised Hernandez's performance and confirmed his interest in signing Jermain Defoe.

Police conducted a bedside interview with the state trooper critically injured in the Poconos sniper shootings and cleared him of having an affair with the sole suspect's sister-in-law. Trooper Alex Douglass asserted he does not know Melissa Frein, wife of fugitive Eric Frein's older brother, according to a source close to the investigation. Police initially suggested that the two, who reside less than half a mile apart in Olyphant, Pennsylvania, might have known each other, and that Eric Frein, sought for 15 days, may have believed they were having an affair. The source stated, 'Douglass said he had not even met her. Of course, we don't know what Eric Frein believed.' Investigators hope Douglass's denial will dispel rumors circulating in the Poconos regarding his involvement with Melissa. During a press briefing, Deputy Police Commander Lt. Col. George Bivens expressed annoyance at questions about the alleged affair, noting that Douglass, shot below the waist, was 'troubled' by the focus on his private life. Douglass, 31, remains in serious but stable condition following the September 12 shooting that killed Corporal Bryon Dickson, 38, a father of two. If Frein believed the trooper was involved with his sister-in-law, it could explain why he traveled 25 miles to the Blooming Grove police barracks to commit the attack instead of choosing a closer target. The FBI and state troopers continued their search for Eric Frein in a wooded area at Buck Hill Falls in Barrett Township, Pennsylvania. Police believe Frein chose Blooming Grove due to its isolation, allowing him to hide in the woods, unlike other stations closer to populated areas. They maintain that it is a coincidence that Douglass lives near Frein's brother. Early in the investigation, police 'aggressively interviewed' Melissa Frein regarding the rumors. Trooper Tom Kelly, a Pennsylvania State Police spokesman, stated, 'We investigated the rumor thoroughly after we learned about it. There is no truth to the affair. We used thorough investigative techniques and questioned Melissa Frein extensively. She denied it, and we do not believe she is being deceptive.' Melissa Frein reportedly passed a polygraph test, supporting the police's conclusion. Melissa is married to Frein's older brother, Michael. Eric Frein was the best man at their 2007 wedding at St. Joseph Melkite Greek Catholic Church in Scranton, Pennsylvania. Melissa Frein has not responded to requests for comment. Bivens labeled Frein, a survivalist with a grudge against law enforcement, an 'assassin.' Addressing Frein, Bivens stated, 'Eric, as I told you last week, you are a coward. Your actions have disrupted an innocent community while you hide. We are not intimidated and will not leave. We have a mission: protect the community, find you, and bring you to justice.' Police have commandeered an abandoned building known as 'The Mansion' in the woods off Snow Hill Road. The site has an airstrip, allowing police helicopters and planes to use it as a base. Bivens believes Frein may have a radio and is monitoring press reports. Police have confined Frein, 31, to a five-square-mile area south of Canadensis but have not sighted him since Tuesday afternoon. Before that, he approached the perimeter of the search area, staying just out of reach. Dogs flushed him out, but he escaped. Bivens believes the search has become a game for Frein. 'To him, it's a game—a war game,' he said. On Saturday, the Philadelphia Inquirer reported that police found a jacket believed to belong to Frein, along with protein bar wrappers. The previous day, the paper reported that bomb-making equipment was found in Frein's parents' home and that Frein tried to call his parents on September 18, which helped police locate him. Bivens implicitly accepted this claim. Bivens also revealed that Frein had purchased bunker-building equipment, but the bunker has not been found. Heavily armed officers have been searching the woods. Searches of Frein's computer showed he had been planning the attack for at least two years, researching police manhunts, law enforcement technology, and survival skills. Bivens said, 'I suspect he wants a fight with state police but I suspect that involves hiding and running, not a face-to-face confrontation—trying to take a shot from a concealed location.' Police previously found soiled diapers and Serbian cigarettes in the woods. Survivalist materials advise wearing diapers for extended stays. Frein is known to be obsessed with Serbia and was a member of Istocni Vuk, a military simulation team reenacting Yugoslav civil wars. Despite assurances that Frein is contained, police continue to search other areas. A helicopter flew over woods west of the search area and extinguished its lights. Heavily armed police sped to the site but found nothing. Earlier that day, police searched the abandoned Inn at Buck Hill Falls, four miles north of the main site. Frein is familiar with the building, a hangout for local teens since its closure in 1991.

Polisi melakukan wawancara di sisi ranjang dengan polisi negara bagian yang terluka parah dalam penembakan penembak jitu di Poconos dan membebaskannya dari tuduhan berselingkuh dengan saudara ipar tersangka utama. Polisi Alex Douglass menegaskan bahwa dia tidak mengenal Melissa Frein, istri dari kakak laki-laki buronan Eric Frein, menurut sumber yang dekat dengan penyelidikan. Polisi awalnya menduga bahwa keduanya, yang tinggal kurang dari setengah mil jauhnya di Olyphant, Pennsylvania, mungkin saling mengenal, dan bahwa Eric Frein, yang dicari selama 15 hari, mungkin percaya mereka berselingkuh. Sumber tersebut menyatakan, 'Douglass mengatakan dia bahkan belum pernah bertemu dengannya. Tentu saja, kita tidak tahu apa yang diyakini Eric Frein.' Penyidik berharap penyangkalan Douglass akan menghilangkan rumor yang beredar di Poconos mengenai keterlibatannya dengan Melissa. Selama konferensi pers, Wakil Komandan Polisi Letnan Kolonel George Bivens menyatakan kejengkelannya atas pertanyaan tentang dugaan perselingkuhan tersebut, mencatat bahwa Douglass, yang ditembak di bawah pinggang, 'terganggu' oleh fokus pada kehidupan pribadinya. Douglass, 31, tetap dalam kondisi serius tetapi stabil setelah penembakan 12 September yang menewaskan Kopral Bryon Dickson, 38, seorang ayah dari dua anak. FBI dan polisi negara bagian melanjutkan pencarian mereka untuk Eric Frein di daerah berhutan di Buck Hill Falls, Barrett Township, Pennsylvania. Polisi percaya Frein memilih Blooming Grove karena lokasinya yang terpencil, yang memungkinkannya untuk bersembunyi di hutan, tidak seperti kantor polisi lain yang lebih dekat dengan daerah berpenduduk. Mereka berpendapat bahwa itu hanyalah kebetulan bahwa Douglass tinggal dekat dengan saudara laki-laki Frein. Tidak ada kebenaran dalam perselingkuhan itu. Kami menggunakan teknik investigasi menyeluruh dan menanyai Melissa Frein secara ekstensif. Dia menyangkalnya, dan kami tidak percaya dia berbohong.' Melissa Frein dilaporkan lulus tes poligraf, yang mendukung kesimpulan polisi. Melissa menikah dengan kakak laki-laki Frein, Michael. Bivens menyebut Frein, seorang survivalis yang menyimpan dendam terhadap penegak hukum, sebagai 'pembunuh'. Berbicara kepada Frein, Bivens menyatakan, 'Eric, seperti yang saya katakan minggu lalu, kamu adalah seorang pengecut. Tindakanmu telah mengganggu komunitas yang tidak bersalah saat kamu bersembunyi. Kami tidak terintimidasi dan tidak akan pergi. Kami memiliki misi: melindungi komunitas, menemukanmu, dan membawamu ke pengadilan.' Polisi telah mengambil alih sebuah bangunan kosong yang dikenal sebagai 'The Mansion' di hutan dekat Snow Hill Road. Lokasi tersebut memiliki landasan pacu, yang memungkinkan helikopter dan pesawat polisi untuk menggunakannya sebagai pangkalan. Bivens percaya Frein mungkin memiliki radio dan sedang memantau laporan pers. Polisi telah membatasi Frein, 31, ke area seluas lima mil persegi di selatan Canadensis tetapi belum melihatnya sejak Selasa sore. Sebelum itu, dia mendekati batas area pencarian, tetap berada di luar jangkauan. Anjing-anjing mengusirnya, tetapi dia melarikan diri. Bivens percaya pencarian itu telah menjadi permainan bagi Frein. 'Baginya, ini adalah permainan—permainan perang,' katanya. Pada hari Sabtu, Philadelphia Inquirer melaporkan bahwa polisi menemukan jaket yang diyakini milik Frein, bersama dengan bungkus protein bar. Sehari sebelumnya, surat kabar itu melaporkan bahwa peralatan pembuat bom ditemukan di rumah orang tua Frein dan bahwa Frein mencoba menelepon orang tuanya pada tanggal 18 September, yang membantu polisi menemukannya. Bivens secara implisit menerima klaim ini. Bivens juga mengungkapkan bahwa Frein telah membeli peralatan untuk membangun bunker, tetapi bunker itu belum ditemukan. Petugas bersenjata lengkap telah mencari di hutan. Pencarian di komputer Frein menunjukkan bahwa dia telah merencanakan serangan itu selama setidaknya dua tahun, meneliti perburuan polisi, teknologi penegak hukum, dan keterampilan bertahan hidup. Bivens berkata, 'Saya menduga dia menginginkan perkelahian dengan polisi negara bagian, tetapi saya menduga itu melibatkan bersembunyi dan melarikan diri, bukan konfrontasi tatap muka—mencoba menembak dari lokasi tersembunyi.' Polisi sebelumnya menemukan popok kotor dan rokok Serbia di hutan. Materi survivalis menyarankan untuk memakai popok untuk waktu tinggal yang lama. Frein dikenal terobsesi dengan Serbia dan merupakan anggota Istocni Vuk, tim simulasi militer yang memerankan kembali perang saudara Yugoslavia. Meskipun ada jaminan bahwa Frein ditahan, polisi terus mencari daerah lain. Sebuah helikopter terbang di atas hutan di sebelah barat area pencarian dan memadamkan lampunya. Polisi bersenjata lengkap bergegas ke lokasi itu tetapi tidak menemukan apa pun. Awal hari itu, polisi menggeledah Penginapan yang ditinggalkan di Buck Hill Falls, empat mil di utara lokasi utama. article_content: By Suzannah Hills PUBLISHED: 08:40 EST, November 19, 2012 | UPDATED: 10:00 EST, November 19, 2012 A father, determined to find his missing daughter, has reunited nine families with their lost children while traveling across China in search of his own. Feng Jianlin's daughter, Feng Yun, was kidnapped by human traffickers in 2008 at the age of nine. Three months after his daughter's disappearance, Jianlin closed his tire shop in Taiyuan, the capital of Shanxi province, and decorated his small truck with pictures of the girl and his phone number. He has since traveled thousands of miles around China in an effort to find her. Determined: Father Feng Jianlin pictured driving his van decorated with the faces of missing children, including his own daughter Yun, who disappeared in 2008. He said, 'We'll never give up looking for her.' 'My wife was overwhelmed and has been sick ever since. My other two daughters miss their sister a lot. We all need her.' Feng Yun had just left home for afternoon classes in March 2008 when she vanished. Her parents appealed for help from the police and relatives in other cities, but their initial searches proved fruitless. But in the four years since his daughter went missing, Feng has never given up hope and has traveled thousands of miles around the country searching for her. As time went by, he started to travel with the parents of other missing children and added their pictures and details to the side of his van. Incredibly, Feng Jianlin has reunited nine parents with their lost children, but tragically, he is still to find his own daughter. Search: Feng Jianlin closed his tire shop in Taiyuan, Shanxi province, and decorated his truck with pictures of his missing daughter Yun before traveling around the country in search of her. On the road: Over time, other parents with missing children have joined Feng on his search. Dedicated: Feng Jianlin has refused to give up on his daughter Yun and has spent the last four years looking for her. 'We don't know how far we can go, but it's the most effective way to find our kids,' said Li Yongfei, who recently traveled with Jianlin to look for his own missing daughter. 'I have to work, so most of the time Feng is the one looking for my child. I really appreciate his help.' Feng now visits city after city, handing out flyers in public squares, and has also set up a website that collects information about lost youngsters. He added, 'If I reach as many people as possible, the chances that I will find someone who knows something about my daughter will greatly increase.' The missing: Feng Jianlin's van features the faces and details of children who have disappeared in recent years. Devastated: A heartbroken mother looking for her missing son appeals to the public for information and help. Feng's family now survives on a basic living allowance from the government. Since Yun disappeared, they have burned through their entire savings and borrowed about 100,000 yuan (approximately £10,000) from relatives. Feng said, 'The pain of failing to find our daughter tortures us every day. But we just can't afford it anymore; we have two other daughters and my aging parents to care for.' There are no official statistics on the number of kidnapped children in China each year, but unofficial numbers suggest that annually, an estimated 30,000 to 60,000 children in China are kidnapped for human trafficking. Campaign: Feng and other families with missing children now travel from city to city handing out leaflets and appealing for information. Unknown: There are no official figures for the number of children who go missing every year, but up to 60,000 are kidnapped for human trafficking.

Kami semua membutuhkannya.' Feng Yun baru saja meninggalkan rumah untuk kelas sore pada bulan Maret 2008 ketika dia menghilang. Orang tuanya meminta bantuan dari polisi dan kerabat di kota-kota lain, tetapi pencarian awal mereka tidak membuahkan hasil. Tetapi dalam empat tahun sejak putrinya menghilang, Feng tidak pernah menyerah dan telah melakukan perjalanan ribuan mil di seluruh negeri untuk mencarinya. Seiring waktu, dia mulai bepergian dengan orang tua dari anak-anak hilang lainnya dan menambahkan gambar dan detail mereka ke sisi van-nya. Luar biasa, Feng Jianlin telah menyatukan kembali sembilan orang tua dengan anak-anak mereka yang hilang, tetapi tragisnya, dia masih belum menemukan putrinya sendiri. Pencarian: Feng Jianlin menutup toko ban-nya di Taiyuan, provinsi Shanxi, dan menghiasi truknya dengan gambar putrinya yang hilang, Yun, sebelum melakukan perjalanan keliling negara untuk mencarinya. Di jalan: Seiring waktu, orang tua lain dengan anak-anak hilang telah bergabung dengan Feng dalam pencariannya. Berdedikasi: Feng Jianlin menolak untuk menyerah pada putrinya, Yun, dan telah menghabiskan empat tahun terakhir untuk mencarinya. 'Kami tidak tahu seberapa jauh kami bisa pergi, tetapi ini adalah cara paling efektif untuk menemukan anak-anak kami,' kata Li Yongfei, yang baru-baru ini bepergian dengan Jianlin untuk mencari putrinya sendiri yang hilang. 'Saya harus bekerja, jadi sebagian besar waktu Feng yang mencari anak saya. Saya sangat menghargai bantuannya.' Feng sekarang mengunjungi kota demi kota, membagikan selebaran di alun-alun publik, dan juga telah membuat situs web yang mengumpulkan informasi tentang anak-anak muda yang hilang. Dia menambahkan, 'Jika saya menjangkau sebanyak mungkin orang, kemungkinan saya akan menemukan seseorang yang tahu sesuatu tentang putri saya akan meningkat pesat.' Yang hilang: Van Feng Jianlin menampilkan wajah dan detail anak-anak yang telah menghilang dalam beberapa tahun terakhir. Hancur: Seorang ibu yang patah hati mencari putranya yang hilang memohon kepada publik untuk informasi dan bantuan. Keluarga Feng sekarang bertahan hidup dengan tunjangan hidup dasar dari pemerintah. Sejak Yun menghilang, mereka telah menghabiskan seluruh tabungan mereka dan meminjam sekitar 100.000 yuan (sekitar £10.000) dari kerabat. Feng berkata, 'Rasa sakit karena gagal menemukan putri kami menyiksa kami setiap hari. Tapi kami tidak mampu lagi; kami memiliki dua putri lain dan orang tua saya yang sudah lanjut usia untuk diurus.' Tidak ada statistik resmi tentang jumlah anak yang diculik di China setiap tahun, tetapi angka tidak resmi menunjukkan bahwa setiap tahun diperkirakan 30.000 hingga 60.000 anak di China diculik untuk perdagangan manusia. Kampanye: Feng dan keluarga lain dengan anak-anak hilang sekarang melakukan perjalanan dari kota ke kota, membagikan selebaran dan memohon informasi. Tidak diketahui: Tidak ada angka resmi untuk jumlah anak yang hilang setiap tahun, tetapi hingga 60.000 anak diculik untuk perdagangan manusia.
