article_content: In Southern California, millions participated in what's being called the largest earthquake drill in history on Thursday morning. People throughout the region dropped to the ground, sheltering under tables for about a minute. A researcher illustrated the potential shock waves of a 7.8-magnitude earthquake spreading across California. Over 5 million people registered to take part in the drill. The event was part of the week-long Great Southern California ShakeOut, organized by scientists and emergency officials to prepare residents for a major earthquake, which experts believe is overdue. Most participants, whether in classrooms, offices, or homes, were instructed to take cover under tables or desks, holding on as if a real, devastating earthquake were shaking buildings. Despite the large number of registrants, organizers cannot precisely determine how many people actually participated at 10 a.m. 'We aimed for a scale that would be difficult to fully manage,' said Mark Benthien, executive director of the Earthquake Country Alliance, regarding the drill. The alliance, consisting of earthquake professionals, emergency personnel, and business and government leaders, organized the drill. Benthien clarified that the registration list is the primary method for estimating participation. 'We aren't receiving formal reports,' he added. Organizers are encouraging unregistered participants to register retroactively to improve the accuracy of the participation count. Medical and emergency personnel engaged in simulated exercises, including responses to staged building collapses and medical emergencies, with drills continuing for several days. Some radio and television stations provided guidance during the drill through special broadcasts. Thursday's drill simulated a magnitude-7.8 earthquake along the southern San Andreas Fault, starting at the Salton Sea and extending north nearly 200 miles. The U.S. Geological Survey estimates such an event could cause 1,800 deaths, 50,000 injuries, and $200 billion in damage. The USGS led a team of over 300 experts in developing the scenario. 'It's not a question of if, but when an earthquake of this size will occur,' according to the Great Southern California ShakeOut's website. In July, a magnitude-5.4 earthquake struck the Los Angeles area, which is significantly weaker than the 'big one' researchers anticipate. Following that earthquake, researchers noted that the stress relieved by smaller tremors was minimal compared to the stress accumulating for the 'big one.' Officials hope the earthquake drill will enhance residents' preparedness for the anticipated major earthquake. 'From a geologist's perspective, it has to be soon,' said Kate Hutton, a seismologist at the California Institute of Technology, in July, referring to a large earthquake. Another moderate quake, a magnitude 5.4, occurred in northern California in April. A magnitude-4.4 quake struck the greater Los Angeles area in August 2007. The Uniform California Earthquake Rupture Forecast indicates a 99 percent chance of California experiencing a quake of magnitude 6.7 or larger within the next 30 years. The forecast was sponsored by the U.S. Geological Survey, the California Geological Survey, and the Southern California Earthquake Center and published in Science Daily in April. Benthien mentioned that other large earthquake drills have occurred in Mexico and South Korea, but 'in terms of the breadth of participation, we believe this is the largest of its kind.' In Japan, an earthquake-prone country, residents conduct an annual earthquake drill on the anniversary of the 1923 Great Kanto earthquake, which resulted in over 100,000 deaths. Several companies are sponsoring the Great Southern California ShakeOut, including Time Warner Cable Inc., a division of Time Warner Inc., the parent company of CNN.
translated_content: Di California Selatan, jutaan orang berpartisipasi dalam apa yang disebut sebagai latihan gempa terbesar dalam sejarah pada Kamis pagi. Warga di seluruh wilayah langsung mencari perlindungan, bersembunyi di bawah meja selama sekitar satu menit. Seorang peneliti menggambarkan potensi gelombang kejut dari gempa berkekuatan 7,8 yang dapat menyebar di seluruh California. Lebih dari 5 juta orang telah mendaftar untuk mengikuti latihan ini. Kegiatan ini merupakan bagian dari acara Great Southern California ShakeOut yang berlangsung selama seminggu, diorganisir oleh para ilmuwan dan petugas keadaan darurat untuk mempersiapkan warga menghadapi gempa besar, yang diperkirakan oleh para ahli akan segera terjadi. Sebagian besar peserta, baik di ruang kelas, kantor, maupun rumah, diinstruksikan untuk mencari perlindungan di bawah meja, berpegangan erat seolah-olah gempa sungguhan sedang mengguncang bangunan. Meskipun jumlah pendaftar sangat banyak, penyelenggara tidak dapat memastikan berapa banyak orang yang benar-benar berpartisipasi pada pukul 10 pagi. “Kami menargetkan skala yang besar sehingga sulit untuk dikelola sepenuhnya,” ujar Mark Benthien, direktur eksekutif Earthquake Country Alliance, mengenai latihan tersebut. Aliansi tersebut, yang terdiri dari para ahli gempa, petugas keadaan darurat, serta pemimpin bisnis dan pemerintahan, mengorganisir latihan ini. Benthien menjelaskan bahwa daftar pendaftaran adalah metode utama untuk memperkirakan jumlah peserta. “Kami tidak menerima laporan resmi,” tambahnya. Penyelenggara mengimbau peserta yang belum mendaftar untuk segera mendaftar agar jumlah partisipan lebih akurat. Petugas medis dan keadaan darurat terlibat dalam latihan simulasi, termasuk memberikan respons terhadap skenario runtuhnya bangunan dan keadaan darurat medis, dan latihan ini akan berlanjut selama beberapa hari. Beberapa stasiun radio dan televisi memberikan panduan selama latihan melalui siaran khusus. Latihan pada hari Kamis ini mensimulasikan gempa berkekuatan 7,8 pada skala Richter di sepanjang Patahan San Andreas bagian selatan, dimulai dari Laut Salton dan meluas ke utara sejauh hampir 320 kilometer. Survei Geologi AS (USGS) memperkirakan bahwa kejadian seperti ini dapat menyebabkan 1.800 korban jiwa, 50.000 luka-luka, dan kerugian sebesar 200 miliar dolar AS. USGS memimpin tim yang terdiri dari lebih dari 300 ahli dalam menyusun skenario ini. “Ini bukan masalah apakah, tetapi kapan gempa sebesar ini akan terjadi,” demikian pernyataan di situs web Great Southern California ShakeOut. Pada bulan Juli, gempa berkekuatan 5,4 pada skala Richter mengguncang wilayah Los Angeles, yang jauh lebih lemah dari “gempa besar” yang diperkirakan oleh para peneliti. Setelah gempa tersebut, para peneliti mencatat bahwa tekanan yang diredakan oleh gempa kecil sangat minim dibandingkan dengan tekanan yang terakumulasi untuk “gempa besar”. Para pejabat berharap latihan gempa ini dapat meningkatkan kesiapsiagaan warga dalam menghadapi gempa besar yang diperkirakan akan terjadi. “Dari sudut pandang ahli geologi, kemungkinan besar akan terjadi dalam waktu dekat,” kata Kate Hutton, seorang seismolog di California Institute of Technology, pada bulan Juli, merujuk pada gempa besar. Gempa sedang lainnya, berkekuatan 5,4 pada skala Richter, terjadi di California utara pada bulan April. Gempa berkekuatan 4,4 mengguncang wilayah Los Angeles Raya pada bulan Agustus 2007. Prakiraan Gempa California yang Seragam (Uniform California Earthquake Rupture Forecast) menunjukkan bahwa ada peluang 99 persen California akan mengalami gempa dengan kekuatan 6,7 atau lebih besar dalam 30 tahun mendatang. Prakiraan ini disponsori oleh Survei Geologi AS (USGS), Survei Geologi California, dan Pusat Gempa California Selatan, dan diterbitkan di Science Daily pada bulan April. Benthien menyebutkan bahwa latihan gempa besar lainnya telah dilakukan di Meksiko dan Korea Selatan, tetapi “dari segi banyaknya peserta, kami yakin ini adalah yang terbesar dari jenisnya.” Di Jepang, negara yang rentan terhadap gempa, warga mengadakan latihan gempa tahunan pada peringatan gempa Kanto Besar tahun 1923, yang menyebabkan lebih dari 100.000 korban jiwa. Beberapa perusahaan menjadi sponsor Great Southern California ShakeOut, termasuk Time Warner Cable Inc., sebuah divisi dari Time Warner Inc., perusahaan induk CNN.

article_content: In London, England, the CNN World Sport team has revealed its selections. Now, it's your turn. As the decade concludes, which sports figures would you include in a top 10 list of achievers from the past 10 years? Selecting the best from the 2000s is a challenging task, especially considering the decade's captivating sporting accomplishments. However, after careful consideration and discussion, the World Sport team has made its choices. The top 10 list includes Tiger Woods, Roger Federer, Michael Phelps, Michael Schumacher, Usain Bolt, Serena Williams, Lance Armstrong (whose achievements are now controversial due to doping), Annika Sorenstam, Kobe Bryant, and David Beckham/Zinedine Zidane. This selection likely holds few surprises for sports enthusiasts. But what about those who didn't make the cut? Valentino Rossi and Sebastien Loeb dominated MotoGP and the World Rally Championship, much like Schumacher's dominance in Formula One since the start of the century. Yet, they are absent from the top 10. Similarly, while Bolt's record-breaking performances in the 100 and 200 meter sprints were remarkable, could one argue that Ethiopian distance runner Kenenisa Bekele and Russian pole vaulter Yelena Isinbayeva were less deserving of recognition? Furthermore, considering that some sports have a more international presence than others, is it fair that the careers of cricketers Shane Warne and Muttiah Muralitharan, American football's Tom Brady, or baseball's Barry Bonds were overlooked in the final analysis? It might also be surprising that soccer, despite its global popularity and numerous star players (Lionel Messi, Samuel Eto'o, Paolo Maldini, Ronaldinho, and Ryan Giggs), only secured the last spot on the official list. Criticisms aside, some selections have garnered approval from respected figures in the sports world. In a recent panel discussion with Laureus World Sport Academy members Sean Fitzpatrick, Sebastian Coe, Boris Becker, and Michael Johnson, Johnson told CNN anchor Pedro Pinto that Bolt deserved his place: "Usain Bolt is extraordinary. When he first broke the 100 meter record, it was only the fourth time he had raced at that distance. He still has room for improvement, but his natural talent sets him apart from the rest." Becker added that Federer's prominent placement was justified: "After winning 13 Grand Slam titles, most tennis players would be content. However, he went on to win his first French Open title in 2009 before securing another victory at Wimbledon." "I've competed against (Jimmy) Connors, (John) McEnroe, (Bjorn) Borg, (Ivan) Lendl, (Andre) Agassi, and (Pete) Sampras -- and it's incredible to witness someone like Federer rewriting the records established by these legends," Becker concluded. article_content: A teenager, Yasmin Tisbury, received a hospital appointment for the year 2099, an 84-year wait. The 19-year-old was referred for an ultrasound scan at Lister Hospital in Stevenage, Hertfordshire, by her GP due to stomach pains. A month later, she received a letter scheduling her appointment for 11am on Thursday, January 1, 2099. By that date, Yasmin would be 103 years old. However, as January 1 is a bank holiday, doctors may not be working. Yasmin spent an hour on hold to resolve the IT error with the hospital. 'I initially found it amusing, but I certainly can't wait 84 years for a scan,' said Yasmin, who is studying animal management. 'Then I became quite annoyed while waiting on the phone. It's a mix-up, but I wanted to get the date sorted. I've already waited a month and am concerned,' she added. She first thought the appointment was for the following January until she saw the year. After tweeting about the experience, Yasmin received a new appointment for the following Tuesday. Lister Hospital in Stevenage admitted the letter was a clerical error. However, Yasmin said the rescheduled appointment clashed with her work experience, requiring her to rearrange it again. East and North Herts NHS Trust stated: 'We appreciate Yasmin bringing this to our attention, as it was clearly a clerical error. 'We know our patients sometimes wait weeks for appointments, but 2099 is excessive. 'We've now arranged an appointment directly with Yasmin to take place within a few days.'

article_content: Football legend Diego Maradona has accused FIFA, the world governing body of football, of corruption and being run by greedy officials who have made millions from the sport. The 1986 World Cup winner made the accusations at his first press conference as coach of Dubai-based club Al Wasl on Saturday, reflecting on the recent FIFA presidential elections where incumbent Sepp Blatter ran unopposed. Blatter's main opponent, Mohamed Bin Hammam of Qatar, was suspended before the vote along with FIFA executive Jack Warner following bribery accusations. 'There is a lot of corruption involving FIFA officials, and they are all millionaires because of football,' the former Argentina player and coach stated. 'I wonder if Blatter has ever kicked a football in his life, yet we have been under the control of such people who have refused to relinquish power in FIFA.' 'Why don't they all just give up their positions, take the money they have made, and leave the running of the sport in the hands of more capable former football players?' Maradona, a controversial figure who was sent home from the 1994 World Cup for using drugs, stated he had never liked the FIFA establishment. 'I don't support corrupt people, and I will never be on their side. They have always asked me to support the FIFA family. But what family are they talking about? This sport belongs to us, and they have never asked us to be part of the development process,' the 50-year-old said. 'They have too much power, making them arrogant and proud. This is not what a genuine football lover needs from such officials. After all, football is the biggest sport in the world.' 'We will continue doing what we are doing so that these corrupt people go away. They are too old, and since they have made so much money at the cost of football, they should simply take it all and leave. Please leave football alone.' Maradona, who arrived more than an hour late for the media briefing, added that FIFA had stifled his attempts to form a players' union. 'What did FIFA do? They worked against us to ensure the union never saw the light of day,' he said. Meanwhile, FIFA is investigating Argentina's 4-1 defeat by Nigeria on Wednesday as part of a broader investigation into match-fixing, according to a report in Britain's Daily Telegraph on Saturday. The paper reported evidence of irregular patterns as referee Ibrahim Chaibou of Niger allowed three extra minutes of injury time in addition to the five already awarded before Argentina scored from a penalty. 'FIFA can confirm that this match between Nigeria and Argentina was one that we had an active interest in and forms part of a wider ongoing investigation,' it said in a statement to the Telegraph. The Nigerian Football Federation released a statement denying the accusation on Saturday. 'We are concerned at attempts by unscrupulous elements to play down the feat that our national team performed by beating Argentina,' general secretary Musa Amadu said. 'This match was shown on many television stations, including ESPN, and in front of a crowd of 50,000, and we are certain that Nigeria's Super Eagles deservedly won that match, playing to the rules, and clearly outplaying our opponents.'

Surat kabar itu melaporkan bukti pola yang tidak biasa ketika wasit Ibrahim Chaibou dari Niger memberikan tambahan waktu tiga menit di luar lima menit yang sudah diberikan, sebelum Argentina mencetak gol dari titik penalti. Federasi Sepak Bola Nigeria mengeluarkan pernyataan yang membantah tuduhan tersebut pada hari Sabtu. 'Pertandingan ini ditayangkan di banyak stasiun televisi, termasuk ESPN, dan di hadapan 50.000 penonton, dan kami yakin bahwa Super Eagles Nigeria pantas memenangkan pertandingan itu, bermain sesuai aturan, dan jelas mengungguli lawan kami.'

article_content: In an unusual turn of events, a man from New Zealand stumbled upon classified U.S. military documents on a second-hand MP3 player. Chris Ogle was in Oklahoma about a year prior when he picked up the device at a thrift shop for just $9. Weeks later, while attempting to load music, he unearthed sensitive military data instead. Speaking to TVNZ, Ogle expressed his growing unease as he examined the files. The information included home addresses, Social Security numbers, and phone numbers of American soldiers. Furthermore, the MP3 player contained what appeared to be mission details and lists of equipment sent to conflict zones in Afghanistan and Iraq. Much of the data seems to originate from around 2005. A New Zealand journalist who initially broke the story managed to reach one of the soldiers using a phone number found within the files. The soldier promptly ended the call upon learning the reason for the contact. Pentagon representatives have acknowledged the situation to CNN but stated they can't comment further until an investigation confirms the origin of the data. Marc Rotenberg of the Electronic Privacy Information Center criticized the government's data protection measures. Privacy experts note that despite efforts to safeguard sensitive information, data breaches are an increasing concern. A past incident involved the Department of Veterans Affairs losing a laptop containing the personal data of millions of individuals. Additionally, classified military hard drives have been discovered for sale in Afghan markets. Rotenberg stressed the danger posed by exposing the personal information of American personnel. Ogle has secured the MP3 player and is willing to return it to U.S. military authorities upon request.

article_content: Nelson Mandela achieved one last victory in death: forcing a collection of the world's dictators to endure a memorial service filled with praise for democracy, freedom, and equality. It's unfortunate that many are focusing on a handshake between President Barack Obama and Cuban President Raul Castro, overlooking the more significant events during Tuesday's memorial service in South Africa. While the handshake was noteworthy, perhaps even meaningful, any satisfaction Castro derived or comfort authoritarian regimes gained from that polite gesture was overshadowed by the event's powerful message and Obama's impactful speech. While Obama may be criticized for other matters, his speech was undeniably a powerful defense of democracy and freedom, bringing discomfort to tyrants in Johannesburg. Obama honored Mandela, 'Madiba,' as 'the last great liberator of the 20th century,' emphasizing his ability to act and take risks for his ideals. Quoting Mandela, Obama highlighted his humanity: 'I'm not a saint, unless you think of a saint as a sinner who keeps on trying,' a sentiment relatable to many. Obama's purpose was not just to praise Mandela but to emphasize the values that made him admirable and the causes that made his struggle resonate globally, causing discomfort among representatives of repressive regimes. Obama noted Mandela's commitment to democracy and the rule of law, exemplified by his willingness to step down from power, a stark contrast to figures like Castro, who has ruled Cuba for over half a century without democratic elections and with reported human rights abuses. Alongside Castro, numerous dictators and their associates attended the memorial, including Swaziland Prime Minister Sibusiso Dlamini, representing a kingdom described as a 'failed feudal state' where the king's actions distract from severe issues. Freedom House reports that two despots have exploited Swaziland, ignoring the needs and rights of the Swazi people, directly opposing Mandela's fight. Mandela's capacity to forgive his enemies was a central part of Obama's message, challenging the visiting VIPs to feel ashamed. Obama quoted Mandela's commitment to fighting both white and black domination, a pointed message to leaders like Robert Mugabe, who, unlike Mandela, clung to power and persecuted white Zimbabweans, causing widespread suffering. Obama directly condemned the hypocrisy of leaders claiming solidarity with Mandela while suppressing dissent, a truth amplified by the celebratory atmosphere. The article lists examples of countries whose representatives should have felt implicated by Obama's words, including envoys from China, Saudi Arabia, Chad, and Jordan, highlighting leaders who are not democratically elected and are guilty of repression. Obama's condemnation of hypocrisy was evident in many responses to Mandela's death, with Syrian President Bashar al-Assad's condolence message being a particularly egregious example. Mandela's life inspired billions due to his commitment to universal values like fair treatment, equality, and the right to choose one's government. U.N. Secretary-General Ban Ki-moon called Mandela 'one of our greatest teachers,' emphasizing the lessons of forgiveness and reconciliation. Mandela, through Obama, delivered one final lesson to despots during his memorial service.
translated_content: Nelson Mandela meraih satu kemenangan terakhir dalam kematian: memaksa sekumpulan diktator dunia untuk menghadiri upacara peringatan yang dipenuhi dengan pujian untuk demokrasi, kebebasan, dan kesetaraan. Sangat disayangkan bahwa banyak yang berfokus pada jabat tangan antara Presiden Barack Obama dan Presiden Kuba Raul Castro, dan mengabaikan peristiwa yang lebih signifikan selama upacara peringatan hari Selasa di Afrika Selatan. Meskipun jabat tangan itu patut diperhatikan, bahkan mungkin bermakna, kepuasan apa pun yang diperoleh Castro atau kenyamanan yang didapatkan rezim otoriter dari sikap sopan itu, menjadi tidak berarti dibandingkan dengan pesan kuat dari acara tersebut dan pidato Obama yang berdampak. Meskipun Obama mungkin dikritik untuk hal-hal lain, pidatonya tak dapat disangkal merupakan pembelaan yang kuat terhadap demokrasi dan kebebasan, yang membuat para tiran di Johannesburg merasa tidak nyaman. Obama menghormati Mandela, 'Madiba,' sebagai 'pembebas besar terakhir abad ke-20,' sambil menekankan kemampuannya untuk bertindak dan mengambil risiko demi cita-citanya. Mengutip Mandela, Obama menyoroti sisi kemanusiaannya: 'Saya bukan orang suci, kecuali jika Anda menganggap orang suci sebagai orang berdosa yang terus mencoba,' sebuah sentimen yang relevan bagi banyak orang. Tujuan Obama bukan hanya untuk memuji Mandela, tetapi untuk menekankan nilai-nilai yang membuatnya dikagumi dan tujuan yang membuat perjuangannya bergema secara global, yang menyebabkan ketidaknyamanan di antara para perwakilan rezim represif. Obama mencatat komitmen Mandela terhadap demokrasi dan supremasi hukum, yang ditunjukkan oleh kesediaannya untuk mengundurkan diri dari kekuasaan, sebuah kontras yang tajam dengan tokoh-tokoh seperti Castro, yang telah memerintah Kuba selama lebih dari setengah abad tanpa pemilihan demokratis dan dengan catatan pelanggaran hak asasi manusia. Selain Castro, banyak diktator dan rekan mereka menghadiri upacara peringatan tersebut, termasuk Perdana Menteri Swaziland Sibusiso Dlamini, yang mewakili kerajaan yang digambarkan sebagai 'negara feodal yang gagal' di mana tindakan raja mengalihkan perhatian dari masalah-masalah serius. Freedom House melaporkan bahwa dua despot telah mengeksploitasi Swaziland, mengabaikan kebutuhan dan hak-hak rakyat Swazi, yang secara langsung bertentangan dengan perjuangan Mandela. Kemampuan Mandela untuk memaafkan musuh-musuhnya adalah bagian penting dari pesan Obama, yang menantang para VIP yang hadir untuk merasa malu. Obama mengutip komitmen Mandela untuk melawan dominasi kulit putih dan kulit hitam, sebuah pesan yang tajam bagi para pemimpin seperti Robert Mugabe, yang, tidak seperti Mandela, berpegang teguh pada kekuasaan dan menganiaya warga kulit putih Zimbabwe, sehingga menyebabkan penderitaan yang meluas. Obama secara langsung mengutuk kemunafikan para pemimpin yang mengklaim solidaritas dengan Mandela sambil menekan perbedaan pendapat, sebuah kebenaran yang diperkuat oleh suasana perayaan. Artikel tersebut mencantumkan contoh negara-negara yang para perwakilannya seharusnya merasa terpengaruh oleh kata-kata Obama, termasuk utusan dari Tiongkok, Arab Saudi, Chad, dan Yordania, yang menyoroti para pemimpin yang tidak dipilih secara demokratis dan bersalah atas tindakan penindasan. Kutukan Obama terhadap kemunafikan terlihat jelas dalam banyak tanggapan terhadap kematian Mandela, dengan pesan belasungkawa Presiden Suriah Bashar al-Assad menjadi contoh yang sangat mencolok. Kehidupan Mandela menginspirasi miliaran orang karena komitmennya terhadap nilai-nilai universal seperti perlakuan yang adil, kesetaraan, dan hak untuk memilih pemerintah mereka sendiri. Sekretaris Jenderal PBB Ban Ki-moon menyebut Mandela 'salah satu guru terhebat kita,' menekankan pelajaran tentang pengampunan dan rekonsiliasi. Mandela, melalui Obama, menyampaikan satu pelajaran terakhir kepada para despot selama upacara peringatannya.

article_content: In a harrowing account, the wife of a victim from the Philippines bus hostage crisis revealed her survival was due to feigning death. The tragic incident unfolded when Rolando Mendoza, a dismissed police officer upset about losing his job, seized a bus carrying tourists from Hong Kong in Manila. The ordeal ended with eight fatalities among the tourists before Mendoza was killed by authorities. Amy Leung, a passenger on the bus, lost her husband and two daughters in the violent confrontation. Her son is currently receiving critical care for his injuries. Leung's husband bravely attempted to stop the assailant, sacrificing himself to protect others. Torn between grief and maternal instinct, Leung chose to play dead, driven by the need to survive for her remaining child. She voiced profound sorrow and questioned the delayed intervention by Philippine authorities. Leung emphasized the gunman's change in behavior after failed negotiations. She criticized the perceived unwillingness of authorities to meet the gunman's demands, suggesting it led to the escalation of violence. Following the tragic event, a chartered flight was arranged to transport approximately 60 officials and relatives back to Hong Kong from Manila, scheduled for Wednesday evening.

article_content: A three-year-old boy has died after falling into a pond at his grandparents' home while playing in their garden. A neighbor who witnessed the emergency services' efforts to save Callum Greenwood said he immediately knew 'something terrible had happened'. Callum was found 10 minutes after being reported missing from a relative's address on Elswick Road, Newcastle, around 6:45 p.m. Police Community Support Officers were present outside the detached property, believed to be the home of the grieving mother's parents. The £300,000 property, located next to St John's Cemetery, is shielded from the road by trees and a stone wall. Next-door neighbor Paul Taylor, 37, a plasterer, said, 'I had gone out to get Indian food and returned to find a large police search underway.' 'They had closed the road, and an ambulance was present.' 'I saw someone wrapped in a blanket being taken into the ambulance.' 'I knew something terrible had happened but didn't know what.' He added, 'It's hard to believe this happened to someone so young.' Northumbria Police have launched an investigation into the circumstances of the boy's death. His partner, Emma Taylor, 38, said, 'We could see people crying and screaming. A woman was hysterical.' 'Even seeing someone being taken to the ambulance, we still didn't know what had occurred.' 'The neighbors are very private. We later learned that the boy was their daughter's child, visiting them.' A man at the property declined to comment. Callum was taken to the Royal Victoria Infirmary, but doctors were unable to save him. Superintendent Mick Paterson, of Northumbria Police, stated, 'This is an incredibly tragic incident, and our thoughts are with the family during this difficult time.' 'They are understandably devastated, and officers are providing them with support.' He confirmed that officers are conducting an inquiry and will prepare a report for the coroner.
translated_content: Seorang anak laki-laki berusia tiga tahun meninggal dunia setelah jatuh ke kolam di rumah kakek-neneknya saat bermain di taman mereka. Seorang tetangga yang menyaksikan upaya petugas layanan darurat untuk menyelamatkan Callum Greenwood mengatakan bahwa dia langsung tahu 'sesuatu yang mengerikan telah terjadi'. Callum ditemukan 10 menit setelah dilaporkan hilang dari alamat keluarga di Elswick Road, Newcastle, sekitar pukul 18.45. Petugas Dukungan Komunitas Polisi berada di luar properti terpisah itu, yang diyakini sebagai rumah orang tua dari ibu yang berduka. Properti senilai £300.000, yang terletak di sebelah Pemakaman St John, terlindung dari jalan oleh pepohonan dan tembok batu yang tinggi. Tetangga sebelah, Paul Taylor, 37, seorang tukang plester, berkata, 'Saya pergi membeli makanan India dan ketika saya kembali, ada pencarian besar-besaran oleh polisi.' 'Mereka telah menutup jalan, dan ada ambulans di sana.' 'Saya melihat seseorang diselimuti dibawa ke dalam ambulans.' 'Saya tahu sesuatu yang mengerikan telah terjadi tetapi saya tidak tahu apa itu.' Dia menambahkan, 'Sulit dipercaya ini terjadi pada anak sekecil itu.' Polisi Northumbria telah meluncurkan penyelidikan atas penyebab kematian anak laki-laki itu. Pasangannya, Emma Taylor, 38, berkata, 'Kami bisa melihat orang-orang menangis dan berteriak. Seorang wanita sangat histeris.' 'Bahkan setelah melihat seseorang dibawa ke ambulans, kami masih tidak tahu apa yang terjadi.' 'Para tetangga sangat tertutup. Kami kemudian mengetahui bahwa anak laki-laki itu adalah cucu perempuan mereka, yang sedang berkunjung.' Seorang pria di properti itu menolak untuk berkomentar. Callum dilarikan ke Royal Victoria Infirmary, tetapi dokter tidak dapat menyelamatkannya. Superintendent Mick Paterson, dari Polisi Northumbria, menyatakan, 'Ini adalah insiden yang sangat tragis, dan kami turut berduka cita bersama keluarga dalam masa sulit ini.' 'Mereka sangat terpukul, dan petugas kami memberikan dukungan kepada mereka.' Dia mengkonfirmasi bahwa petugas sedang melakukan penyelidikan dan akan menyiapkan laporan untuk koroner.

article_content: By Daily Mail Reporter PUBLISHED: 07:18 EST, August 21, 2013 UPDATED: 07:20 EST, August 21, 2013 A grandmother who booked a dream package holiday to Portugal arrived at her hotel only to find she had been taken to Spain. Thomas Cook flew June Burns, 66, and her friend Susan Jones to Faro Airport in Portugal, then transported them by bus 100 miles across the border to Spain’s Costa de la Luz. Upon returning to England, June complained to the tour operator, who offered her £200 in compensation. Disappointed: June Burns, 66, (pictured) is still waiting for the trip to Portugal that she asked Thomas Cook to book, after being sent to Spain instead. Mrs. Burns, from Swinton, Manchester, is still awaiting the £1,247 Portuguese holiday she paid for. She stated, 'The customer service representatives keep asking, "What’s wrong? Didn’t you like the hotel?" And I keep explaining that the hotel was fine, but I wasn’t in Portugal. It’s like booking a holiday to Scotland and ending up in England.' 'If I sit down and ask a holiday company to book me a holiday to the Algarve, I expect to end up in the right country.' Mrs. Burns, 66, booked the break at the Thomas Cook store in Manchester's Trafford Centre. She said, 'I used to work for a cruise operator, so I’ve been to most of Europe but had never been to Portugal, so I was really keen to go.' The tour operator informed Mrs. Burns that they had found her a seven-day trip to the Algarve, the southernmost point of mainland Portugal. Armed with a booking confirmation, she eagerly packed, looking forward to the region’s beautiful hilltop villages and beaches. However, after the flight to Faro Airport, the trip took an unexpected turn. Holiday snaps: The friends said that while the hotel and food were satisfactory, it wasn't the Algarve experience Mrs. Burns had booked through Thomas Cook. In Spain: Mrs. Burns booked the holiday for herself and her friend Susan Jones (right). They wanted to visit Portugal's Algarve but ended up at the Punta Umbria Beach Hotel (left) on Spain's Costa de la Luz, near Huelva. June recounted, 'During the journey, people commented on the Spanish road signs, but we dismissed it. Upon arriving at the hotel, it dawned on us that we weren’t in Portugal.' 'I approached the rep and asked, "Where are we?" She replied, "Spain, is there a problem?" I said, "Yes, I should be in the Algarve." She simply stated that moving us would be difficult due to potential hotel availability issues and suggested we would enjoy it there.' With no alternative, Mrs. Burns and her companion proceeded with the holiday at the Punta Umbria Beach Hotel, near Huelva. She added, 'The food was good and the place was clean, but we were stuck in Spain in the middle of nowhere.' 'It’s the kind of place where everyone just sits by the pool all day. I ended up spending a fortune on day trips to Seville, where I’d visited before.' June Burns and her friend Susan Jones were flown to Faro, in the Algarve region of Portugal, then driven 100 miles to a hotel in Punta Umbria, near Huelva, in Spain. Since her return, Mrs. Burns has visited the Trafford Centre store twice to complain and made three calls to customer services. Compensation was offered only after the press was notified. A spokeswoman for Thomas Cook UK & Ireland stated, 'We understand the importance of holidays to our customers and apologize for any misunderstanding that occurred when Mrs. Burns booked her holiday with us.' 'While Mrs. Burns did not question her holiday confirmation documents prior to travel, at which point we could have amended her booking, we can confirm that we are in communication with her to resolve this matter to her satisfaction.' Mrs. Burns' holiday confirmation document indicated ‘Costa de la Luz, Algarve’ as the destination. Some travel agents refer to Costa de la Luz as ‘the Spanish Algarve,’ but Punta Umbria Beach Hotel is not located in the Algarve. On Thomas Cook’s website, it is listed under Spain, with no mention of ‘Algarve.’

Thomas Cook menerbangkan June Burns, 66 tahun, dan temannya, Susan Jones, ke Bandara Faro di Portugal, lalu mengangkut mereka dengan bus sejauh 160 kilometer melintasi perbatasan ke Costa de la Luz di Spanyol. 'Jika saya duduk dan meminta perusahaan liburan untuk memesankan saya liburan ke Algarve, saya berharap untuk berakhir di negara yang benar.' Operator tur memberi tahu Nyonya Burns bahwa mereka telah menemukan perjalanan tujuh hari ke Algarve, titik paling selatan daratan Portugal. Berbekal konfirmasi pemesanan, dia dengan bersemangat berkemas, menantikan desa-desa dan pantai-pantai indah di wilayah tersebut. Namun, setelah penerbangan ke Bandara Faro, perjalanan itu mengalami perubahan yang tak terduga. Foto liburan: Teman-teman mengatakan bahwa meskipun hotel dan makanannya memuaskan, itu bukanlah pengalaman Algarve yang dipesan Nyonya Burns melalui Thomas Cook. June menceritakan, 'Selama perjalanan, orang-orang mengomentari rambu jalan Spanyol, tetapi kami mengabaikannya. Setibanya di hotel, kami menyadari bahwa kami tidak berada di Portugal.' 'Saya mendekati perwakilan dan bertanya, "Kita ada di mana?" Dia menjawab, "Spanyol, apakah ada masalah?" Saya berkata, "Ya, saya seharusnya berada di Algarve." Dia hanya menyatakan bahwa memindahkan kami akan sulit karena potensi masalah ketersediaan hotel dan menyarankan agar kami menikmatinya di sana.' Tanpa alternatif lain, Nyonya Burns dan temannya melanjutkan liburan di Punta Umbria Beach Hotel, dekat Huelva. Dia menambahkan, 'Makanannya enak dan tempatnya bersih, tetapi kami terjebak di Spanyol di antah berantah.' 'Ini adalah jenis tempat di mana semua orang hanya duduk di tepi kolam renang sepanjang hari. Saya akhirnya menghabiskan banyak uang untuk perjalanan sehari ke Seville, tempat saya pernah kunjungi sebelumnya.' June Burns dan temannya, Susan Jones, diterbangkan ke Faro, di wilayah Algarve Portugal, kemudian berkendara sejauh 160 kilometer ke sebuah hotel di Punta Umbria, dekat Huelva, di Spanyol. Sejak kepulangannya, Nyonya Burns telah mengunjungi toko Trafford Centre dua kali untuk mengeluh dan melakukan tiga panggilan ke layanan pelanggan. Kompensasi ditawarkan hanya setelah pers diberi tahu. Seorang juru bicara Thomas Cook UK & Ireland menyatakan, 'Kami memahami pentingnya liburan bagi pelanggan kami dan meminta maaf atas kesalahpahaman yang terjadi ketika Nyonya Burns memesan liburannya bersama kami.' 'Meskipun Nyonya Burns tidak mempertanyakan dokumen konfirmasi liburannya sebelum bepergian, dan saat itu kami dapat mengubah pemesanannya, kami dapat mengonfirmasi bahwa kami sedang berkomunikasi dengannya untuk menyelesaikan masalah ini demi kepuasannya.' Dokumen konfirmasi liburan Nyonya Burns menunjukkan 'Costa de la Luz, Algarve' sebagai tujuan. Beberapa agen perjalanan menyebut Costa de la Luz sebagai 'Algarve Spanyol,' tetapi Punta Umbria Beach Hotel tidak terletak di Algarve. Di situs web Thomas Cook, hotel ini terdaftar di bawah Spanyol, tanpa menyebutkan 'Algarve.'
